item.title: El IBEX 35 abre en rojo lastrado por el castigo a las tecnológicas tras el IPC estadounidense
item.description: El IBEX 35 abrió el jueves a la baja, lastrado por un dato de inflación en Estados Unidos más elevado de lo previsto que reavivó el temor a unas tasas de interés más altas y que golpeó con especial dureza al sector tecnológico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El IBEX 35 (.IBEX) abrió el jueves a la baja, lastrado por un [USN:L6N4600VI TEXT:"dato de inflación"] en Estados Unidos más elevado de lo previsto que reavivó el temor a unas tasas de interés más altas y que golpeó con especial dureza al sector tecnológico. La brusca [USN:L6N46018U TEXT:"oleada de ventas"] en los valores ligados a la inteligencia artificial se prolongó tras el cierre de Wall Street y se intensificó en la sesión asiática, mientras los mercados que el año pasado compraban exposición al auge de la IA temen ahora que estas compañías se vean asfixiadas por su deuda antes de rentabilizar sus inversiones. La perspectiva de un encarecimiento del dinero [USN:L6N4601A4 TEXT:"castigó"] a los títulos de Oracle, CoreWeave y otras firmas del sector sensibles al alza de los costes de financiación tras conocerse el IPC estadounidense. "El dato (de inflación en EEUU) penalizó sobre todo a tecnología que acusó un previsible mayor coste de capital", indicó el departamento de análisis de Bankinter en una nota previa a la apertura. CoreWeave, operador de centros de datos en pérdidas que adeuda cerca de 50.000 millones de dólares, según datos de LSEG, se situó en el epicentro del desplome, con una caída del 15% el miércoles y de otro 6% tras el cierre, lo que evaporó una quinta parte de su valor. Pese a ello, los ingresos que reciben los fabricantes de chips siguen siendo enormes y crecientes: TSMC, el mayor productor mundial de chips para IA, [USN:L6N4610DY TEXT:"anunció"] el jueves su sexto trimestre consecutivo de beneficios récord. La penalización en las bolsas alimentó la búsqueda de refugio en la [USN:L1N460126 TEXT:"renta fija"]. Después de repuntar brevemente al conocerse un IPC estadounidense más elevado de lo esperado, la deuda pública a diez años de Estados Unidos recuperó terreno y amplió las ganancias en Asia, beneficiándose del desplazamiento de fondos procedentes de la renta variable. Con todo, el IPC de septiembre puso en guardia a los inversores, y la herramienta FedWatch de CME elevó al 31,6% la probabilidad implícita de una subida de tasas de la Reserva Federal (Fed) el 28 de octubre, frente al 22,1% del día anterior. La atención se dirige ahora a las intervenciones de responsables de la Fed en Bangkok, entre ellos su presidente, Kevin Warsh, en busca de pistas sobre el próximo paso del banco central, así como a los datos de precios de producción y ventas minoristas que se publican este jueves. Por lo demás, el mercado seguía de reojo los acontecimientos geopolíticos y la evolución de las materias primas, con el [USN:L6N4610H1 TEXT:"crudo Brent cediendo"] un 1,7%, hasta los 104,20 dólares por barril, mientras los operadores sopesaban el efecto del [USN:L6N4610DF TEXT:"levantamiento de las sanciones"] estadounidenses sobre la oferta frente a los ataques al tráfico marítimo en el estrecho de Ormuz. Aun así, los analistas de Bankinter apuntaron a una posible mejora según avance la jornada: "El tono de primera hora es de cautela. Sin embargo, pensamos que el saldo podría mejorar a medida que avanza la sesión con el respaldo de los sólidos resultados de TSMC y unas valoraciones más atractivas tras los retrocesos de la semana (-1,2% en EEUU y, -3% en tecnología y -7% en semis)". De momento, a las 0701 GMT, el selectivo bursátil español IBEX 35 caía 28,50 puntos, un 0,15%, hasta 19.202,20 puntos, mientras que el índice de grandes valores europeos FTSE Eurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) retrocedía un 0,40%. En el sector bancario, Santander (SAN.MC) perdía un 1,06%, BBVA (BBVA.MC) retrocedía un 0,91%, Caixabank (CABK.MC) cedía un 0,67%, Sabadell (SABE.MC) caía un 0,91%, Bankinter (BKT.MC) se dejaba un 0,75% y Unicaja Banco (UNI.MC) perdía un 0,68%. Entre los grandes valores no financieros, Telefónica (TEF.MC) se anotaba un 1,21%, Inditex (ITX.MC) avanzaba un 0,66%, Iberdrola (IBE.MC) se revalorizaba un 0,83%, Cellnex (CLNX.MC) ganaba un 2,17% y la petrolera Repsol (REP.MC) perdía un 0,07%.

item.title: PetroChina Expands Singapore Marine Fuel Business With First LNG Delivery
item.description: PetroChina International will carry out its first liquefied natural gas bunkering operation in Singapore on Thursday, Chairman Wu Junli said, expanding its alternative marine fuel offerings at the world’s largest ship refueling port. The trading arm of Chinese state energy major PetroChina was one of …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
PetroChina International will carry out its first liquefied natural gas bunkering operation in Singapore on Thursday, Chairman Wu Junli said, expanding its alternative marine fuel offerings at the world’s largest ship refueling port.

The trading arm of Chinese state energy major PetroChina was one of eight companies awarded LNG bunkering licenses by Singapore’s government. It also holds a license to supply methanol to ships.

PetroChina will complete the acquisition of a methanol bunker vessel on Friday, Wu told the Singapore International Bunkering Conference.

The expansion comes as shipowners order more vessels capable of running on alternative fuels, although infrastructure to supply those fuels is struggling to keep pace.

Citing Clarksons data, Wu said global orders for alternative-fuel vessels had approached 2,000 ships by the end of 2025, including more than 1,200 LNG-fuelled vessels.

“Methanol-fuelled vessels are expanding rapidly, while ammonia-fuelled vessels are beginning to gain momentum,” he said.

However, the number of existing and planned methanol bunkering ports worldwide remained below 50, compared with 220 LNG bunkering ports, Wu said.

PetroChina accounted for about 10% of Singapore’s bunker fuel sales last year, when the port’s total sales exceeded 56 million metric tons.

The company sold 7.95 million tons of bunker fuel globally last year and can supply 18 ports using 16 bunker vessels on time charter, Wu said.

PetroChina completed its first commercial LNG bunkering operation in Europe last year and secured qualification to supply methanol as marine fuel in Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

China has annual green methanol production capacity of 380,000 tons, Wu added.

item.title: 日経平均は6日続落、一時5％超安 ＡＩ投資懸念で関連株急落
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は大幅に６日続落し、前営業日比４．９...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は6日続落、一時5％超安　ＡＩ投資懸念で関連株急落 16:01 配信

東京証券取引所。２０２０年１０月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は大幅に６日続落し、前営業日比４．９０％（３３１８円３４銭）安の６万４４２５円９５銭で取引を終えた。下落幅は過去３番目の大きさとなった。前日の米市場でＡＩ（人工知能）投資懸念が強まり、東京市場でも関連銘柄が軒並み大幅安となった。日経平均は一時５％超安となる場面があった。一方、ディフェンシブ株には買いもみられたほか、決算を受けた個別物色は活発だった。

日経平均は前営業日比１．２８％安でスタートした後、徐々に下げ幅を拡大。後場には一時６万４０９２円７４銭まで値下がりした。前日の米市場では、ＡＩ向けクラウドサービスを提供するコアウィーブの株価が約１５％下落した。市場では、ＡＩインフラ投資が減速に向かう可能性が改めて意識された。加えて、９月の米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が市場予想を上振れたことも金利の先高観につながり、ハイテク株の重しとなった。日本株市場でも指数寄与度の大きい半導体関連株を中心に売りが加速した。一方、医薬品や小売など内需関連株は堅調に推移し、ディフェンシブ株には買いも入った。

後場終盤には台湾のＴＳＭＣ決算の内容が伝わったが、相場の反応は限定的だった。

松井証券のチーフマーケットアナリスト・窪田朋一郎氏は「米国ではデータセンター投資が持続するか懸念が強まっている。また、国内の半導体関連株は需給面で上値が重くなるとみられ、日経平均は２００日線が位置する６万１０００円近辺まで調整が深まる可能性もある」と指摘する。

目先は企業決算に投資家の関心が向かうが、「半導体関連企業では、足元の好業績は見込めるものの、先行きに対して企業側がどのようなメッセージを発信するか注目」（窪田氏）だという。

ＴＯＰＩＸは２．３８％安の３９９９．３４ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比２．３８％安の２０６１．３ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は１０兆１４０１億２５００万円だった。東証３３業種では、医薬品、不動産、小売など１０業種が値上がり。非鉄金属、電機機器、ガラス・土石製品など２３業種は値下がりした。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が３日続落し、３．２１％安の７５６．５３ポイントだった。

個別では、ソフトバンクグループ、東京エレクトロン、アドバンテストが大幅下落し、３銘柄で日経平均を２０００円超押し下げた。キオクシアホールディングス、フジクラも大幅安。

一方、前日に決算を発表した良品計画は大幅高。同じく前日に決算とメニューの値上げを発表したサイゼリヤも大幅上昇した。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが５６４銘柄（３６％）、値下がりは９４８銘柄（６１％）、変わらずは４０銘柄（２％）だった。

item.title: Nestle India's quarterly profit rises as demand for packaged foods stays firm
item.description: Nestle India reported a 36% jump in second-quarter profit on Thursday, underpinned by resilient demand for its packaged foods and beverages, including Maggi noodles and KitKat chocolates.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nestle India (NEST.NS) reported a 36% jump in second-quarter profit on Thursday, underpinned by resilient demand for its packaged foods and beverages, including Maggi noodles and KitKat chocolates. The Indian unit of Swiss food major Nestle (NESN.S) said its net profit rose to 10.27 billion rupees ($108.03 million) in the quarter ended September 30 from 7.53 billion rupees a year earlier. ($1 = 95.0625 Indian rupees)

item.title: Una guerra larga y nuevas perturbaciones son el mayor riesgo para Oriente Medio, dice el FMI
item.description: El Fondo Monetario Internacional dijo el jueves que una guerra prolongada en Oriente Medio y la reaparición de perturbaciones en la producción energética, las rutas marítimas o las infraestructuras críticas suponen el mayor riesgo para las economías de Oriente Medio y Asia Central.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: El Fondo Monetario Internacional dijo el jueves que una guerra prolongada en Oriente Medio y la reaparición de perturbaciones en la producción energética, las rutas marítimas o las infraestructuras críticas suponen el mayor riesgo para las economías de Oriente Medio y Asia Central. Yihad Azour, director del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para Oriente Medio y Asia Central, dijo a los periodistas que la guerra estaba provocando un impacto económico muy desigual en toda la región, y que los Estados directamente afectados se encontraban sometidos a una fuerte presión. "Las perspectivas dependen fundamentalmente de la rapidez con la que se normalicen la producción y el comercio de energía, así como de la capacidad de los países para preservar la estabilidad macroeconómica", dijo Azour en una rueda de prensa celebrada durante las reuniones anuales del FMI y el Banco Mundial en Bangkok. El FMI publicará unas perspectivas más completas para la región el 22 de octubre. Los excedentes previos a la guerra, las rutas alternativas, los ajustes en la demanda y las importantes reducciones de las existencias habían ayudado a contener el impacto de la crisis energética provocada por los ataques liderados por EEUU e Israel contra Irán y el posterior cierre del estrecho de Ormuz por parte de Teherán. "Estas reservas han permitido ganar tiempo, pero son limitadas. Las existencias son más bajas, la capacidad de reserva es más ajustada y una nueva interrupción podría generar ajustes de precios mucho mayores", señaló. La entidad crediticia mundial prevé una profunda contracción del 1,3% en la región de Oriente Medio, el norte de África y Pakistán tras un crecimiento del 3,3% en 2025, seguida de un repunte fuerte, pero desigual, en 2027, cuando se espera que el crecimiento alcance el 6,6%, señaló Azour, quien destacó las diferencias sustanciales existentes en toda la región. La previsión parte de la base de que el comercio y el transporte marítimo volverán a la normalidad en el primer trimestre de 2027, con una normalización gradual de las exportaciones a mediados de año y unos precios del petróleo que se mantendrán en niveles elevados. Azour señaló que la previsión se basaba en una rápida reanudación de la producción, y destacó que Qatar, por ejemplo, había sido capaz de acelerar su recuperación a pesar de haber sufrido una destrucción masiva de su capacidad de gas natural. No obstante, señaló que la crisis tendría un impacto devastador en diversos sectores, ya que los daños en las infraestructuras requerirían un gasto adicional, y que los riesgos se inclinaban a la baja. Los países exportadores de petróleo directamente afectados por la guerra experimentarían una contracción significativa en 2026 y un fuerte repunte del crecimiento en 2027 a medida que se normalizara la producción energética, aunque se esperaba que la producción se mantuviera por debajo de las previsiones a medio plazo anteriores a la guerra. Las economías de los países importadores de petróleo de la región habían demostrado su resiliencia y se esperaba que siguieran siéndolo, dijo. La región del Cáucaso y Asia Central había capeado la crisis relativamente bien y se esperaba que la inflación siguiera descendiendo desde niveles elevados. El FMI prevé que el crecimiento se ralentice hasta el 5,2% en 2026 y luego hasta el 5% en 2027, desde el 6,2% registrado en 2025. Azour señaló que los dirigentes económicos deberían dar prioridad a la estabilidad de precios, centrarse en la reconstitución de los colchones fiscales y ampliar su capacidad para resistir futuras crisis.

item.title: Central Ukrainian region hit by vast drone attack, killing three
item.description: The central Ukrainian region of Kirovohrad was hit by the largest Russian attack on its territory during the war, killing three people and wounding another six overnight, the local governor said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The central Ukrainian region of Kirovohrad was hit by the largest Russian attack on its territory during the war, killing three people and wounding another six overnight, the local governor said on Thursday. The region, a relatively infrequent target of bombardment, was hit by over 360 drones, governor Andriy Raikovych wrote on Telegram, adding that 26 different locations had been hit. "The enemy deliberately hit critical infrastructure, transport enterprises, logistics facilities and residential homes," he wrote. Ukraine's air force said 580 Russian drones attacked the country overnight, of which 536 were shot down.

item.title: El presidente de Taiwán pide a Micron y sus trabajadores negociar "con sinceridad" ante posible huelga
item.description: El presidente de Taiwán, Lai Ching-te, pidió el jueves al fabricante estadounidense de chips de memoria Micron Technology y a sus trabajadores que negocien "con sinceridad" ante una posible huelga del sindicato de la empresa en Taiwán.
item.dc:creator: Yi-Chin Lee, Ann Wang
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Taiwán, Lai Ching-te, pidió el jueves al fabricante estadounidense de chips de memoria Micron Technology (MU.O) y a sus trabajadores que negocien "con sinceridad" ante una posible huelga del sindicato de la empresa en Taiwán. La semana pasada, un sindicato taiwanés que representa a trabajadores de Micron dijo que había obtenido autorización de sus afiliados para convocar una huelga por una disputa sobre el sistema de bonificaciones de la empresa, lo que intensificaba el conflicto laboral en el mayor centro de producción del fabricante de chips. Micron emplea a unas 15.000 personas en Taiwán, uno de sus centros de producción más importantes, y ha afirmado que invirtió más de 1,6 billones de dólares taiwaneses (49.400 millones de dólares estadounidenses) en la isla. Durante la inauguración en Taichung de una nueva planta de ensamblaje y pruebas avanzados de Micron, Lai expresó su esperanza de que el Gobierno y el sector privado pudieran colaborar para mejorar la comunicación entre los trabajadores y la dirección. "También esperamos que tanto los trabajadores como la dirección mantengan el espíritu de que los peces necesitan agua y el agua necesita peces, y sigan negociando con sinceridad y de buena fe para alcanzar el consenso más amplio posible", añadió. "Sólo mediante unas relaciones laborales armoniosas pueden ganar ambas partes, de modo que los empleados puedan trabajar con tranquilidad y las empresas avancen con paso firme y lleguen más lejos". Lai dijo que valoraba el compromiso de Micron con Taiwán y que esperaba que siguiera ampliando sus inversiones en la isla. Añadió que Micron había obtenido apoyo gubernamental para la investigación y el desarrollo de memorias de alto ancho de banda (HBM). Taiwán es un centro de producción crucial para los chips de memoria DRAM y HBM de Micron, utilizados en servidores de inteligencia artificial. Manish Bhatia, presidente y director de operaciones de Micron, no mencionó la posible huelga en su intervención, poco antes de la de Lai. "Ya hemos vendido toda la capacidad de producción que esta fábrica tendrá en 2027 y esperamos que las memorias de alto ancho de banda crezcan más rápido que el resto de la industria de DRAM hasta finales de 2028", dijo. El sindicato de Micron en Taichung dijo a Reuters que esperaba que la empresa entablara con sus representantes "un diálogo y unas negociaciones más sustanciales". Ni Micron ni su otro sindicato, en Taoyuan, respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios sobre las declaraciones de Lai. (1 dólar estadounidense = 32,3730 dólares taiwaneses)

item.title: La producción de cobre de Antofagasta sube un 7% en el trimestre y mantiene su previsión para 2026
item.description: La minera chilena Antofagasta reportó el jueves un aumento del 7% en su producción de cobre del tercer trimestre y mantuvo sus previsiones anuales, ante la expectativa de que una mayor producción en los últimos meses de 2026 compense las pérdidas de producción del primer trimestre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La minera chilena Antofagasta (ANTO.L) reportó el jueves un aumento del 7% en su producción de cobre del tercer trimestre y mantuvo sus previsiones anuales, ante la expectativa de que una mayor producción en los últimos meses de 2026 compense las pérdidas de producción del primer trimestre. La compañía produjo 151.900 toneladas métricas de cobre en el tercer trimestre, lo que elevó la producción acumulada en lo que va de año a 436.900 toneladas, un 8,3% menos que en el mismo periodo de 2025. Una caída del 7,6% en el primer trimestre, debido a menores leyes del mineral y tasas de recuperación en Centinela, llevó a la empresa a recortar este año su estimación de producción para 2026 a entre 625.000 y 655.000 toneladas. La previsión anterior se situaba entre 650.000 y 700.000 toneladas. También prevé una producción de entre 630.000 y 690.000 toneladas en 2027, gracias a mayores leyes del mineral en Los Pelambres. La mina paralizó sus operaciones en julio, después de que lluvias extremas llevaran al Gobierno de Chile a declarar el estado de catástrofe en la región de Coquimbo. La minera, que cotiza en Londres, volvió a elevar sus estimaciones de costos de caja antes de descontar los ingresos por subproductos a entre 2,60 y 2,70 dólares por libra, frente al rango anterior de entre 2,40 y 2,60 dólares, debido a la persistencia de los elevados precios de los combustibles.

item.title: Gold Fields' CEO plays down prospect of higher Northern Star offer
item.description: Gold Fields' CEO played down speculation that the South African gold producer is going to raise its offer for Northern Star, saying the Australian target first needs to acknowledge that it is open to a merger.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Gold Fields' (GFIJ.J) CEO played down speculation that the South African gold producer is going to raise its offer for Northern Star, saying the Australian target first needs to acknowledge that it is open to a merger. Gold Fields has embarked on a long-planned road show in Australia this month, where CEO Mike Fraser is aiming to boost its profile with investors in the country which accounts for about half of its business. It last month lobbed a A$38.7 billion ($27.1 billion) buyout proposal in shares and cash for Perth-based Northern Star, Australia's biggest gold miner, to create the world's second-biggest producer of the yellow metal. But Northern Star, hampered by a run of poor performance, [USN:L1N45K003 TEXT:"rebuffed"] that offer, choosing instead its own plans for operational overhaul, pushed by activist investor [USN:L4N4291EG TEXT:"Elliott"] Investment Management. Both miners have gold operations in Western Australia, including around the town of Kalgoorlie where Northern Star runs Australia's biggest gold mine, known as the Super Pit. Northern Star said in a statement that its board remained focused on acting in the best interests of shareholders. "This includes engaging with parties on proposals that represent value above what we believe Northern Star can generate as a standalone company. The Gold Fields proposal was not in that category," it said. Fraser said the market expected Gold Fields to make another offer. "But I think before you get into, you know, throwing in new offers, you've got to at least have some reciprocation to say, actually we think there is a pathway (to value) here," Fraser told Reuters. "At the moment, we're not hearing any of that." Gold Fields has said it saw $4 billion to $5 billion in synergies, which analysts attribute mostly to tax benefits and combining operations in a Western Australian gold hub. However, one overlooked benefit was the prospect a combined company could rerate, he said. "We absolutely believe that this combined business would be trading at a much higher relative multiple than what we're trading at today," he said. Gold Fields' shares are trading on an enterprise multiple of 3.5 to 4 times earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation, much cheaper than Northern Star's multiple of 7 to 8 times. Larger peer, Agnico Eagle (AEM.TO) is also trading around an 8 times multiple.

item.title: El papa León pasó bien la noche en el hospital, según el Vaticano
item.description: El papa León, que se recupera de una intervención quirúrgica por un cáncer de pulmón, pasó una buena noche en el hospital y desayunó, según informó el Vaticano este jueves.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El papa León, que se recupera de una intervención quirúrgica por un cáncer de pulmón, pasó una buena noche en el hospital y desayunó, según informó el Vaticano este jueves. A León, de 71 años, se le ha diagnosticado un adenocarcinoma de pulmón, el tipo más común de cáncer de este órgano, y los médicos le extirparon el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho en una intervención quirúrgica realizada el martes por la tarde. El Vaticano afirmó que la intervención se llevó a cabo con éxito, sin complicaciones. Aún no se ha revelado el tamaño del tumor ni si la enfermedad se había extendido a los ganglios linfáticos cercanos, factores clave para determinar el pronóstico. Se esperan más novedades este jueves, aunque es posible que el reporte patológico del papa no esté disponible hasta dentro de varios días. Se han cancelado los compromisos públicos de León hasta el 20 de octubre.

item.title: ウクライナ大統領、ロ製油所攻撃再開へ スターリンク速度低下「意図的」
item.description: [１５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１５日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアの製油所への攻撃を再開すると明らかにした。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）のインタビューで語った。

ゼレンスキー氏は１３日、トランプ米大統領が「エネルギー停戦」を発表したことを受け、ロシアのエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を２日間停止したと述べていた。

ＦＴが１５日掲載したインタビューでは「（製油所攻撃の）停止はもうやめる。終わりだ」と述べた。また、トランプ政権がロシアとのビジネス取引に積極的なことや、トランプ氏がロシアのプーチン大統領を称賛しているように見えることを批判した。

ウクライナ軍が攻撃を停止したにもかかわらず、ロシアの弾道ミサイルに関する米国の早期警戒情報を受け取れなくなったと語った。イーロン・マスク氏の衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の通信速度が国内全域で低下し、前線での作戦やロシアの軍事拠点への中距離攻撃に支障が出たとした。

ウクライナ軍当局者は米国の担当者から「（エネルギー施設への攻撃を）やめなければ、情報提供を止める」と告げられたという。スターリンクの障害については、技術的な不具合という説明があったとしたが、ゼレンスキー氏は「意図的なもの」と指摘した。

米政権との関係修復に向けてエネルギー施設への攻撃停止に応じるかと問われると、ゼレンスキー氏は、見返りに米国製の迎撃ミサイル「パトリオット」を追加で供与されるなら同意できると答え、それが受け入れられる「最低限」の条件だとした。

item.title: This Chinese export boom really has legs – and wings
item.description: Overproduction at home is pushing cheap Chinese protein onto global supermarket shelves, undercutting established producers.
item.dc:creator: Daphne Zhang, Ella Cao, Lewis Jackson
item.content:encoded: Employees trim and process chicken breast meat at Wintop's factory in Tengzhou, Shandong province. Exports accounted for half of the Chinese company's profits last year. REUTERS/Ella Cao TENGZHOU, China — In an office reeking of cigarettes, Dang Yangyang slouches on a black leather sofa in exhaustion. The general manager at Wintop Food has spent recent days chaperoning clients from Ghana, Iraq, Jordan, Russia and Senegal. They all want the same thing: Chinese chicken. Wintop processes 60 million chickens annually, selling breasts, nuggets, meatballs and dumplings to more than 20 countries. Exports accounted for half of its profits last year and are underwriting 33 acres of expansion. “International clients used to distrust the quality,” Dang, 44, told Reuters during a tour of his facilities in August. “But when the meat is $1,000 cheaper per ton than Brazilian and Thai competitors, they have to either buy from China or lose out." Dang Yangyang, general manager of Wintop Food, inspects chicken breast meat as he speaks to Reuters at his office in Tengzhou. Dang says Chinese poultry has a significant price advantage over rivals. REUTERS/Ella Cao The company is part of a wave of Chinese protein producers overcoming the country’s patchy food-safety record and leveraging additional capacity to seize space on global supermarket shelves. Changing diets at home and Beijing’s emphasis on food security have pushed companies to invest in technology and expansion. Now, they produce more than China can consume and are unloading excess production abroad. The surge in cheap Chinese protein is drawing scrutiny from Western producers and regulators, signaling fresh trade friction. The pattern echoes Beijing's strategy in steel, solar panels and electric vehicles — flooding markets with low-priced products that undercut global rivals. In July, the European Commission launched an anti-dumping probe into Pekin duck imports after local producers alleged Chinese subsidies created unfair competition. Last month, the commission imposed anti-dumping duties of between 41% and 67% on Chinese pea protein. Chicken has so far avoided the same action, though European authorities are monitoring the market, a commission spokesperson told Reuters. Agriculture and food are among the few categories where China still runs a trade deficit. At just over $100 billion last year, the gap is massive but shrinking. China, already the world’s largest source of seafood exports, last year became a net exporter of chicken. Overall, China exported $2.6 billion worth of chicken products last year, almost double 2020 levels, customs data show. Dairy exports are on track to hit $600 million this year, doubling in three years. For global consumers, the trend means cheaper protein. For foreign producers from Europe to Thailand and Brazil, it means new competitors. China’s shift from buyer to emerging exporter is having a “disruptive” effect on the global meat market, said Michael Boddington, a Beijing-based agribusiness consultant. In Asia, he said, shipments traditionally flowed in from Europe and the Americas. Now, there's a cheaper alternative — and producers globally are scrambling to compete. China’s agriculture and commerce ministries didn’t respond to Reuters questions about the country’s burgeoning protein exports. URBANITES SHUN PORK For decades, protein in China meant pork. Pigs fed the workers who built the cities and staffed the factories that powered the country's economic boom. China became home to half the world’s hogs, whose appetite for grain, especially soybeans, redrew trade flows from the US Midwest to Brazil. The country’s appetite for pork provided livelihoods for small farmers like Huang Weiying, who started raising pigs in her village in Hebei province 20 years ago, owning more than 500 at a peak. Farmer Huang Weiying, 57, stands in her barn in Wuqiao county, in China's Hebei province, in August. Pork prices have slumped as supply has outpaced demand. REUTERS/Ella Cao Farmer Su Jinzhu, 61, feeds his pigs inside his barn in Wuqiao county. He told Reuters he plans to sell them by next year. REUTERS/Ella Cao Pig prices are so low. People in the cities just stopped eating pork. Huang Weiying, a pig farmer in Hebei province. But that era is over. When Reuters visited Huang in August, she was tossing slop to her last 10 hogs in a cobweb-covered barn. Some $75,000 in debt, she planned to slaughter them by autumn. “I have been raising pigs for over two decades, but it has never been as hard as the last two years,” Huang, 57, said. “Pig prices are so low. People in the cities just stopped eating pork.” The fatty pork cuts common in traditional Chinese cuisine have fallen out of favor with health-conscious urbanites. Per-capita pork consumption has fallen 13% since peaking in 2023, according to official data and state media. Chicken intake rose more than 50% per capita in the decade through 2024. Yet production kept expanding across China’s meat and dairy sectors. Officials encouraged massive buildout with subsidies targeted at large corporate producers to boost food security and rebuild herds after the 2018 African swine fever outbreak and the covid-19 pandemic. Subsidies accounted for about 13% of Chinese agricultural producers' gross farm receipts between 2022 and 2024, according to the OECD — nearly triple the level in the early 2000s. Today, subsidized farms are contributing to overcapacity. Production has hit new highs despite an economic slowdown, tepid domestic demand and a shrinking population, government data show. Last year, China produced a record 59 million metric tons of pork; poultry output rose 7%. The dairy sector surpassed official targets for 2025 production two years early. Pork prices are hardest hit because domestic demand is weakest, but prices have also fallen for poultry and dairy. MOVING OVERSEAS For the large producers who increasingly predominate, the way out is exports. “Every Chinese livestock company is planning to expand overseas. If you want to grow, you must go abroad,” said Zhang Yuan, head of baby formula marketing at dairy giant Yili, which plans to start selling formula in Southeast Asia as soon as next year. It’s a symbolic step for Asia’s largest dairy company, which had milk products pulled in a 2008 government crackdown after melamine contamination sickened thousands of babies . The scandal turned consumers away from domestic milk for more than a decade. But Yili baby milk powder is now the top-selling brand in China. Yili’s competitor, Feihe, launched its AceKid infant formula in Indonesia in April to compete with Nestlé and Mead Johnson, after bringing the product to the Philippines a year earlier. Feihe didn’t respond to requests for comment. Dairy cows are milked in an automated milking system at a Yili Group ranch in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia. REUTERS/Daphne Zhang AceKid baby formula produced by Chinese company Feihe sits on a shelf at a store in Jakarta, Indonesia, in August. REUTERS/Willy Kurniawan Poultry producers are treading a similar path. At Wintop, in Shandong province, manager Dang has increased the number of chickens in each shed from 20,000 to 120,000 in a decade. The birds weigh 2.5 kg on average – compared with 2.2 kg for broilers from Brazil, according to S&P Global. They are slaughtered in under 42 days instead of 45, catching up to the 35-day US standard. The local Tengzhou government is subsidizing the wage bill for Wintop’s more than 2,000 workers, the company told Reuters without offering specifics. Tengzhou authorities didn’t respond to a request for comment. Rival processors such as Sunner are relying on higher-value processed products such as marinated chicken and ready meals to drive growth. Its overseas sales rose 42% to $135 million last year. Sunner told Reuters it is expanding the global presence of its breeds by working with countries including Uzbekistan to develop local capacity. The company developed China's first domestically bred white-feather broiler and has begun selling it in Africa and Central Asia. TOUGH COMPETITOR As Chinese producers go abroad, they are grabbing market share from established players. Chinese milk powder now competes with products from New Zealand and Europe in countries including Nigeria and Bangladesh, and is displacing Indian and Iranian producers in the Middle East, according to Yifan Li, dairy analyst at commodity broker StoneX. China has doubled its share of the European Union processed-poultry market to 10% since 2022, and tripled its share in the UK to more than 14%, according to data from Gira, a food consultancy. That growth is challenging producers such as Germany. China’s share of the Japanese market is also edging higher while the leader, Thailand, is slipping. “It’s very worrying,” said Kukrit Arepagorn, manager at the Thai Broiler Processing Exporters Association, an industry body. “Customers increasingly use cheap Chinese chicken prices as a reference point for negotiation.” Ezequiel Pires, chairman of Lisbon-based international meat trader Branexx, said his company began buying Chinese poultry in March after African customers sought cheaper alternatives to Brazilian imports. Chinese breast meat and leg quarters are 10% to 20% cheaper than Brazilian products, Pires said. China hasn’t fully shaken some of the negative associations arising from persistent food-safety scandals, analysts say. For its exporters, the challenge is to build “lasting confidence in the safety, traceability and consistency of their products," said Gordon Butland, director at Bangkok-based G&S Agriconsultants. Employees process chicken meat at Wintop's factory in Tengzhou. Chinese poultry producers are grabbing market share from established players. REUTERS/Ella Cao A refrigerator outside Wintop's factory in Tengzhou displays the company's products for domestic and export markets. REUTERS/Ella Cao In the EU, imported food must meet the same health and safety standards as local produce, the European Commission told Reuters. The bloc plans to strengthen EU-origin labeling, starting with poultry products in 2027. Some clients prefer Thai poultry for its consistent taste and quality, said Rupert Claxton, meat and livestock director at Gira. Still, for many customers, China’s lower price point is key. "We're exporting to whatever countries we can,” said Wintop’s Dang. “If you have a significant price advantage, many customers actively seek you out." Editor's note: This story was updated after publication to correct the type of duck that is subject to a European anti-dumping probe.

item.title: Air India forms team to drive cost savings, memo shows
item.description: Air India has set up a dedicated team to identify cost savings across operations and tightened spending approvals as the airline grapples with airspace disruptions, the Middle East conflict and high jet fuel costs, CEO Tewolde Gebremariam told employees in an internal memo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Air India has set up a dedicated team to identify cost savings across operations and tightened spending approvals as the airline grapples with airspace disruptions, the Middle East conflict and high jet fuel costs, CEO Tewolde Gebremariam told employees in an internal memo. The carrier faces mounting pressure to restore profitability and rebuild confidence in its safety standards after recording a loss of more than $2 billion in the fiscal year ended March and coming under regulatory scrutiny following a fatal [USN:L6N43H09S TEXT:"crash"] in June 2025 that killed 260 people. In August, two people familiar with the matter [USN:L4N44M0L1 TEXT:"told"] Reuters that Air India was seeking about $1.5 billion in fresh equity from its owners Tata Sons and Singapore Airlines (SIAL.SI) . The airline has also faced safety and compliance lapses, including operating aircraft without valid certifications, while Pakistan's airspace ban and conflict-related disruptions in the Middle East have forced longer routes, cancellations and cuts to international services. Air India's efforts to modernise an ageing fleet have been hampered by shortages of seats and other components, delaying cabin upgrades, while it is seeking to defer deliveries of hundreds of aircraft on order to curb costs. The challenges confront new [USN:L4N4421HC TEXT:"CEO"] Tewolde [USN:L6N4420ZU TEXT:"Gebremariam"] as he tries to turn around the airline, which has not reported a profit since returning to private ownership in 2022. In the memo, Tewolde said Air India had set up a dedicated cross-functional team to identify cost-saving opportunities across the organisation. He also announced an employee initiative to reward ideas that cut costs or boost revenue, urging staff to embed frugality and accountability into everyday decisions.

item.title: Romania's nominated prime minister secures support ahead of confidence vote
item.description: Romania's leftist Social Democrats said they will join the government of Prime Minister-designate Luca Niculescu while other parties pledged their votes, edging the country closer to ending a political crisis that has pressured its investment-grade rating.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Romania's leftist Social Democrats said they will join the government of Prime Minister-designate Luca Niculescu while other parties pledged their votes, edging the country closer to ending a political crisis that has pressured its investment-grade [USN:L8N45M0N4 TEXT:"rating"]. The Social Democrats (PSD), parliament's largest party, will have 11 ministers in the proposed [USN:L8N45R14H TEXT:"government"] Niculescu will unveil on Thursday before a parliamentary vote of confidence, PSD leader Sorin Grindeanu said late on Wednesday. Technocrats will fill other ministerial posts, including finance, energy and foreign affairs. While other pro-European parties refrained from joining the cabinet, many said they will back Niculescu, ensuring the 233 votes required to win the vote of confidence. Niculescu, 55, a diplomat, former journalist and currently interim deputy foreign minister, will lead centrist President Nicusor Dan's fourth attempt to install a government in the five months since a pro-European broad coalition cabinet collapsed. The four-party government led by Liberal Party head Ilie Bolojan [USN:L1N41I0F8 TEXT:"collapsed"] in early May when the PSD quit and teamed up with the far-right opposition to file a no-confidence vote. The PSD have repeatedly said they would form a similar coalition with a different prime minister, but the Liberals and two other centre-right parties have refused. The months-long political crisis has pushed the Romanian leu currency to record lows while debt yields surged. The European Union state [USN:L8N43Y04L TEXT:"narrowly avoided"] a ratings downgrade from the last rung of investment grade. [USN:L4N45O18X TEXT:"Ratings agencies"] have all said that Romania's ability to approve a 2027 budget that further cuts one of the EU's largest deficits will be key for the country's rating. While Niculescu's government was set to get parliament's approval, it was unclear how long it would last. The PSD will join on condition that a 2027 budget plan be unveiled by December 1, with no further tax hikes, and Grindeanu said it will assess the cabinet in six months. Romania has agreed with Brussels to bring its budget deficit below 3% of economic output - from over 9% in 2024 and an expected 6.2% this year - by 2030.

item.title: France-L'inflation IPCH accélère comme prévu à +3,4% sur un an en septembre
item.description: L'inflation en France, harmonisée selon les normes européennes (IPCH), a accéléré comme attendu à +3,4% sur un an en septembre, montrent les données définitives publiées jeudi par l'Insee.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'inflation en France, harmonisée selon les normes européennes (IPCH), a accéléré comme attendu à +3,4% sur un an en septembre, montrent les [USN:S8N43O05M TEXT:"données définitives"] publiées jeudi par l'Insee. L'indice IPCH, qui permet les comparaisons avec les autres pays de la zone euro, était également ressorti à +3,4% en [USN:L8N45M0EM TEXT:"première lecture"], après +2,6% en août. Sur un mois, l'indice IPCH se replie de 0,3% en septembre, après +0,7% en août. L'indice était ressorti à -0,4% lors de la première estimation. L'indice des prix à la consommation (IPC), l'inflation calculée selon les normes françaises, ressort pour sa part à +3,1% sur un an en septembre, soit légèrement plus que prévu en première estimation (+3,0%) et après +2,4% en août. Sur un mois, l'IPC a reculé de 0,3%, comme en première lecture et après +0,7% en août.

item.title: South African rand edges up as next week's medium-term budget draws focus
item.description: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Thursday as the dollar slipped from an 18-month peak, with investors looking ahead to next week's medium-term budget for clues on the country's fiscal outlook and credit rating prospects.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Thursday as the dollar slipped from an 18-month peak, with investors looking ahead to next week's medium-term budget for clues on the country's fiscal outlook and credit rating prospects. At 0638 GMT, the rand traded at 16.5575 against the dollar , about 0.3% firmer than its previous close. The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of peers, fell, ceding most of the gains it made after stronger-than-expected US inflation data on Wednesday pushed it to an 18-month high. Investors will be watching Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana's medium-term budget policy statement next week amid expectations of an improving budget balance and a more favourable ratings outlook. "The rand is looking to US markets for direction, but the (medium-term budget policy statement) will keep traders in limbo," ETM Analytics said in a note. South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond was also firmer in early deals, as the yield fell 6.5 basis points to 8.69%.

item.title: British Land expects robust interim growth on office, retail park demand
item.description: British Land said on Thursday it expects strong interim profit and rental income growth, driven by demand for its London office campuses and retail parks, with cost savings offsetting higher interest expenses and lower lease surrender premiums.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British Land (BLND.L) said on Thursday it expects strong interim profit and rental income growth, driven by demand for its London office campuses and retail parks, with cost savings offsetting higher interest expenses and lower lease surrender premiums. The real estate group expects underlying profit of £166 million ($219.68 million) for the six months ended September 30, up from £155 million a year earlier, with underlying earnings per share of 16.1 pence British Land said the 12% like-for-like rental income growth for the first half, development lease-ups and cost savings more than offset the drag from higher interest rates and reduced surrender premiums - one-off payments from tenants exiting leases early The landlord, which counts Citadel and Gilead among its tenants, said its campus developments continued to lease up at record rents, with 1 Broadgate and One Triton Square now fully let It said its retail parks portfolio remained virtually full at 99% occupancy, with leasing 9.6% ahead of previous passing rents British Land reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 expectation of underlying EPS of at least 30.5 pence ($1 = 0.7556 pounds)

item.title: Jupiter Fund Management reports higher third-quarter inflows, assets hit record
item.description: British asset manager Jupiter Fund Management reported higher third-quarter net inflows on Thursday, helped by improving client demand and stronger flows across its investment strategies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British asset manager Jupiter Fund Management (JUP.L) reported higher third-quarter net inflows on Thursday, helped by improving client demand and stronger flows across its investment strategies. Here are some details: Net inflows totalled £700 million ($926.31 million) in the third quarter, compared with £300 million a year earlier, reversing second-quarter outflows of £800 million Improving investor sentiment and demand for greater geographic diversification supported flows during the quarter, helping offset market volatility linked to renewed tensions in the Middle East The update extends a recovery in client demand after Jupiter recorded its first year of positive net inflows since 2017 in 2025 Assets under management rose 51% to a record £75.9 billion at September 30, compared with £50.4 billion a year earlier Retail, wholesale and investment trust net inflows reached £1.0 billion, marking a fifth consecutive quarter of positive flows ($1 = 0.7557 pound)

item.title: UK's Travis Perkins reports fall in like-for-like sales amid construction slump
item.description: British building materials supplier Travis Perkins on Thursday reported a 1.3% fall in like-for-like sales in the third quarter, as construction activity and consumer spending remain subdued amid geopolitical uncertainty.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British building materials supplier Travis Perkins (TPK.L) on Thursday reported a 1.3% fall in like-for-like sales in the third quarter, as construction activity and consumer spending remain subdued amid geopolitical uncertainty. Soaring mortgage rates along with rising construction costs and inflation have prolonged the downturn in construction activity, weighing on demand from tradespeople, a major customer base for the company The firm, which operates the Toolstation UK brand, reported a 1.6% fall in third-quarter group revenue The company noted a tougher comparison from discounts provided in the same quarter a year ago Travis Perkins' stock is down 6.6% this year, despite receiving a temporary boost from the UK's '[USN:L6N45K0EC TEXT:"Your First Home'"] scheme that is expected to lift new home construction Under CEO Gavin Slark, it initiated a turnaround plan that includes raising prices to pass on cost increases due to the Middle East conflict "Our ongoing cost discipline and trading approach are protecting profitability whilst we continue to identify and implement further operational efficiencies," Slark said

item.title: French inflation rises to 3.4% in September, highest since January 2024
item.description: Consumer prices in France rose 3.4% year-on-year in September on an EU-harmonised basis, statistics office INSEE said on Thursday, in line with a preliminary reading from late September.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Consumer prices in France rose 3.4% year-on-year in September on an EU-harmonised basis, statistics office INSEE said on Thursday, in line with a preliminary reading from late September. The harmonised inflation rate in the bloc's second-biggest economy — adjusted for comparison with other euro zone countries — accelerated in September compared with the August reading of 2.6% and was at its highest level since January 2024.

item.title: Pope Leo had a good night in hospital, Vatican says
item.description: Pope Leo, recovering from surgery for lung cancer, had a good night in hospital and has eaten breakfast, the Vatican said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pope Leo, recovering from surgery for lung cancer, had a good night in hospital and has eaten breakfast, the Vatican said on Thursday. Leo, 71, has been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer, and doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung in a surgery on Tuesday afternoon. The Vatican has said the surgery was completed successfully, without complications. It has not yet disclosed the size of the tumour or whether the disease had spread to nearby lymph nodes, key factors in determining prognosis. Further updates are expected on Thursday, but the pope's pathology report may not be available for several days. Leo's public schedule has been canceled until October 20.

item.title: Kommunen erneut mit Rekordeinnahmen aus der Gewerbesteuer
item.description: Die deutschen Kommunen haben bei der Gewerbesteuer erneut Rekordeinnahmen erzielt. Trotz Konjunkturflaute nahmen sie im Jahr 2025 brutto rund 76,4 Milliarden Euro ein, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Donnerstag mitteilte. Das ist ein Plus von 1,5 Prozent oder rund 1,1 Milliarden Euro zum Vorjahr. Damit wurde der fünfte Rekordwert in Folge seit dem Rückgang im Corona-Jahr 2020 erreicht. Insgesamt stiegen die Einnahmen der Gemeinden aus Grund- und Gewerbesteuer, den sogenannten Realsteuern, um 1,3 Prozent auf 92,5 Milliarden Euro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die deutschen Kommunen haben bei der Gewerbesteuer erneut Rekordeinnahmen erzielt. Trotz Konjunkturflaute nahmen sie im Jahr 2025 brutto rund 76,4 Milliarden Euro ein, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Donnerstag mitteilte. Das ist ein Plus von 1,5 Prozent oder rund 1,1 Milliarden Euro zum Vorjahr. Damit wurde der fünfte Rekordwert in Folge seit dem Rückgang im Corona-Jahr 2020 erreicht. Insgesamt stiegen die Einnahmen der Gemeinden aus Grund- und Gewerbesteuer, den sogenannten Realsteuern, um 1,3 Prozent auf 92,5 Milliarden Euro. Die Entwicklung verlief in den Bundesländern jedoch sehr unterschiedlich. Die höchsten Zuwächse bei der Gewerbesteuer verzeichneten Schleswig-Holstein und das Saarland mit jeweils 13,0 Prozent sowie Hamburg mit 11,1 Prozent. In fünf Bundesländern waren die Einnahmen hingegen rückläufig. Am stärksten war der Rückgang in Bremen mit zwölf Prozent, gefolgt von Baden-Württemberg mit einem Minus von 7,2 Prozent und Sachsen mit einem Minus von 6,9 Prozent. Die deutsche Wirtschaft ist im vergangenen Jahr um 0,2 Prozent gewachsen. Für 2026 rechnen viele Ökonomen mit einem kräftigen Anstieg des Bruttoinlandsproduktes von etwa 1,3 Prozent, weil die Exporte besser laufen als gedacht und der Staat Milliarden für Infrastruktur und Verteidigung ausgibt. Bei besserer Konjunktur steigen in der Regel auch die Einnahmen der Kommunen aus der Gewerbesteuer. Dennoch ist die Finanzlage vieler Gemeinden prekär: Wegen steigender Zinskosten, hohen Personalaufwands und mehr Sozialausgaben verharrte deren Finanzierungsdefizit im ersten Halbjahr mit 20,1 Milliarden Euro auf dem Rekordwert des Vorjahreszeitraums. Das Aufkommen aus der Grundsteuer blieb 2025 mit 16,1 Milliarden Euro im Vergleich zum Vorjahr insgesamt unverändert. Dabei sanken die Einnahmen aus der Grundsteuer A für land- und forstwirtschaftliche Betriebe um 19,6 Prozent auf 0,3 Milliarden Euro. Die Einnahmen aus der Grundsteuer B für sonstige Grundstücke stiegen dagegen leicht um 0,7 Prozent auf 15,8 Milliarden Euro. Die Höhe der Einnahmen wird maßgeblich von den Hebesätzen bestimmt, die die Gemeinden festlegen. Der durchschnittliche Hebesatz für die Gewerbesteuer stieg bundesweit nur leicht um einen Prozentpunkt auf 410 Prozent.

item.title: EasyJet on track to close Apollo deal by first quarter 2027
item.description: EasyJet on Thursday published the scheme document for its £5.7 billion ($7.54 billion) takeover by Apollo , setting a shareholder vote for November and reaffirming its expectations to close the deal before the end of the first quarter of 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: EasyJet (EZJ.L) on Thursday published the scheme document for its £5.7 billion ($7.54 billion) takeover by Apollo (APO.N) , setting a shareholder vote for November and reaffirming its expectations to close the deal before the end of the first quarter of 2027. ($1 = 0.7557 pounds)

item.title: UK retailer Dunelm's quarterly sales rise as demand for curtains, kitchenware rebounds
item.description: British homeware retailer Dunelm posted a marginal rise in first-quarter sales on Thursday, as demand for curtains, shutters and kitchenware rebounded after exceptionally warm weather dampened trading.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British homeware retailer Dunelm (DNLM.L) posted a marginal rise in first-quarter sales on Thursday, as demand for curtains, shutters and kitchenware rebounded after exceptionally warm weather [USN:L4N4500EF TEXT:"dampened"] trading. Total sales rose 1.1% to £433 million ($572.99 million) in the 13-week period ended September 26 Digital sales, which include home delivery, Click & Collect and orders placed on in-store tablets, rose 1% and accounted for 41% of total sales Dunelm has been trying to revive growth under Chief Executive Clo Moriarty, who set out a three-year plan to simplify product ranges and pricing to cut costs The Leicester-based company affirmed its annual profit expectations Dunelm, however, warned that first-half profit will fall below prior-year levels, as the benefits of its cost-cutting measures are expected to be weighted toward the second half ($1 = 0.7557 pounds)

item.title: 台湾総統、マイクロン労使に誠実な交渉要請 スト実施の可能性で
item.description:
Yi-Chin Lee Ann Wang
[台中 １５日 ロイター] - 米メモリー半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
台湾総統、マイクロン労使に誠実な交渉要請　スト実施の可能性で 15:42 配信

マイクロン・テクノロジーの施設。９月、台湾の桃園市で撮影。REUTERS/Ann Wang

Yi-Chin Lee　Ann Wang

[台中 １５日 ロイター] - 米メモリー半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーの台湾の労働組合がストライキに踏み切る可能性があることを受け、頼清徳総統は１５日、労使双方に誠実な交渉を呼びかけた。

同労組は先週、賞与制度を巡る対立で、組合員からスト実施の承認を得たと発表した。同社は主要な製造拠点の一つである台湾で約１万５０００人を雇用している。

頼氏は台中で開かれたマイクロンの新たな先端組み立て・検査施設の開所式で、政府と民間が協力し、労使間の対話がさらに深まるよう後押しすることに期待を示した。

労使双方が誠意を持って交渉を続け、できる限り幅広い合意を築くことを望むとし、「調和の取れた労使関係を築いてこそ双方が利益を得られ、従業員が安心して働き、企業も着実に歩みを進め、さらに発展できる」と語った。

頼氏はマイクロンの台湾への取り組みに謝意を示し、投資を引き続き拡大することを期待していると述べた。また、同社が広帯域メモリー（ＨＢＭ）の研究開発で政府の支援を確保したと説明した。

マイクロンのマニシュ・バティア社長兼最高執行責任者（ＣＯＯ）は、頼氏に先立って行ったあいさつで、ストの可能性には言及しなかった。「この工場の２０２７年の生産能力に相当する分は、すでに全て売約済みだ。ＨＢＭは２８年まで一貫して、ＤＲＡＭの他の分野を上回るペースで成長すると見込んでいる」と述べた。

item.description:
Takahiko Wada

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
利上げ「特定のペースは考えず」、会合ごとに判断＝小枝日銀委員 15:36 配信

日本銀行本店。都内で２０２４年３月撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada

［熊本市　１５日　ロイター］ - 日銀の小枝淳子審議委員は１５日午後の記者会見で、今後の利上げについて「特定のペースを考えているわけではない」と話した。９月に続き１０月の金融政策決定会合でも利上げを決める可能性を問われたが、「その都度、経済・物価・金融環境を点検して判断していく」と述べるにとどめた。

午前の懇談会のあいさつでは、緩和的な金融環境が続くもとで、物価上昇リスクが「相応にある」ことを踏まえれば、利上げに「過度に慎重になることはない」と話していた。
