item.title: China, North Korea open long-delayed border bridge to boost trade
item.description: China and North Korea officially opened their most significant land border crossing on Thursday, aiming to rejuvenate trade and commerce after years of strained ties and pandemic-related disruptions.
item.dc:creator: Florence Lo, Mandy Leong
item.content:encoded: China and North Korea officially opened their most significant land border crossing on Thursday, aiming to rejuvenate trade and commerce after years of strained ties and pandemic-related disruptions. Trucks festooned with the national flags of the neighbours drove across the long-delayed 3-km (2-mile) New Yalu River Bridge, its towering pylons also decked in flags, linking the Chinese city of Dandong with North Korea. Knots of spectators crowded a road on the Chinese side overlooking the cable-stayed bridge completed in 2014 but unused while the North left its approach roads and customs compound unfinished. "(Bilateral) relations are entering a new phase, embarking on a new chapter," Chinese Premier Li Qiang said in a video address at the [USN:L6N46004I TEXT:"opening"], the official Xinhua news agency said. The border crossing would "strongly promote" economic and trade cooperation and further strengthen exchanges between their people, he added. It also offers an opportunity to improve border clearance procedures, boost connectivity and build cooperation in border areas, Li said. North Korean Premier Pak Thae Song also delivered a video address, Xinhua said, but the North Korea's state media have yet to report on the event. 'NO IMMEDIATE RETURN TO PRE-SANCTIONS TRADE' The opening is the latest sign of warming ties between Beijing and Pyongyang, after two summits between their leaders in the past year. Despite the potential economic boost from active trade, however, analysts said North Korea remains cautious of greater dependence on China. "The bridge is unlikely to lead immediately to a full-scale return to pre-sanctions trade," said Lim Eul-chul at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies. But the bridge will help move heavy equipment, raw materials and energy products that North Korea needs for development efforts, he said. China is by far Pyongyang's largest trading partner, even after a series of UN sanctions banned the flow of goods and workers with the North over the latter's missile and nuclear weapons development. China and Russia, permanent members of the UN Security Council that voted to approve sanctions resolutions until 2017, have since questioned the legitimacy and efficacy of such bans. Russia is accused by countries such as the US and South Korea of supplying sensitive military assistance to the North in return for Pyongyang's help in fighting the war in Ukraine. DELAY WAS SETBACK FOR DANDONG'S ECONOMY The delay in opening the bridge was a [USN:L8N45U017 TEXT:"setback for Dandong"], whose economy thrived in the early 21st century as the primary trade gateway to North Korea's isolated economy. Until now, most goods have crossed about 10 km (6 miles)upstream, using an 83-year-old bridge with a rail track and a single-lane road. That remains the busiest of about 15 crossing points along the roughly 1,350-km (840-mile) border. Dandong residents welcomed the opening. "It’s been more than a decade since they first said the bridge would open... but coming here today and seeing it for myself makes me incredibly happy," said one of them, a 50-year-old surnamed He. "Once the bridge opens, this place will become much livelier, attracting more tourists," said another Dandong resident, surnamed Xie. The bridge opening was "effectively the first visible case" of adoption of agreements struck at a June summit of leaders, a South Korean Unification Ministry official said on Thursday. Seoul was monitoring whether it would lead to further practical steps as Beijing and Pyongyang seek to build their ties into a more strategic partnership, the official added. China's exports to North Korea rose to a six-year high of $2.3 billion last year, an increase of 25% on the year. Still, that was well below levels before UN sanctions tightened in 2017.

item.title: 英財務相、ロシア「影の船団」制裁強化を訴え ＩＭＦ総会で
item.description:
David Milliken
[バンコク １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Milliken

[バンコク １５日 ロイター] - 英国のヒーリー財務相は１５日、ロシア関連の海運に対する制裁を強化するよう各国に呼びかけた。タイの首都バンコクで開催されている国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）年次総会に合わせ、各国の財務相と会談するのを前に述べた。

ヒーリー氏は「ウクライナを巡り、きょうここに集まった財務相に伝えたいのは、ロシアに対する厳しい経済制裁を堅持することだ。特にプーチン（ロシア大統領）が制裁逃れに使う影の船団の活動を支える海運サービスの禁止を強化する必要がある」と語った。

英国は、ロシアがウクライナとの戦争の資金や装備を調達するために利用していると見なす海運や関連サービスに対し、一連の制裁を科している。

一方、米当局者は１４日、トランプ政権が、過去最高水準にある世界の海上輸送運賃を引き下げるため、ロシアやイラン、ベネズエラなどの原油・石油製品を輸送してきた「影の船団」への制裁緩和を検討していると明らかにした。

トランプ大統領はロシア産ディーゼル燃料（軽油）への制裁を一時解除し、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領や欧州諸国のほか、米上院の与党共和党議員の一部からも批判が相次いでいる。

ヒーリー氏はまた、２０２５年にロシアのドローン（無人機）攻撃で損傷したウクライナのチョルノービリ（チェルノブイリ）原子力発電所の修復に向け、英国が１７００万ポンド（２３００万ドル）を拠出すると表明した。米国とフランスも支援する。

このほか、今後数年間で政府借り入れを削減する英国の計画をＩＭＦが評価したことを歓迎。１０月２８日に行う自身初の年次予算演説でも、この方針を堅持すると確認した。

item.title: 英ＧＳＫ、ベルギーで最大1217人削減へ 3カ年再編計画開始
item.description: [ブリュッセル １４日 ロイター] - 英製薬大手グラクソ・スミスクライン（ＧＳＫ）は１４日、ベルギーで最大１２１７人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英ＧＳＫ、ベルギーで最大1217人削減へ　3カ年再編計画開始 11:34 配信

グラクソ・スミスクライン（ＧＳＫ）のロゴ。２０２２年８月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[ブリュッセル １４日 ロイター] - 英製薬大手グラクソ・スミスクライン（ＧＳＫ）は１４日、ベルギーで最大１２１７人の従業員を削減する可能性があると発表した。１９億ポンド（２５億ドル）のコスト削減を目指す３カ年計画が実行段階に入ったことを示す動きだ。

ルーク・ミエルズ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は７月にこの計画を開始していた。医薬品開発を加速するとともに、主力薬である抗エイズウイルス（ＨＩＶ）薬「ドルテグラビル」の特許切れが迫る中、ＧＳＫがこれを乗り切れると投資家を安心させるための広範な取り組みの一環となる。

変更点にはデジタルツールの活用拡大や自動化の推進を通じた研究、製造、支援業務の簡素化が含まれる。

提案されている人員削減は、ブリュッセルの南東に位置するリクサンサール、ワーブル、ジャンブルーにある拠点に勤務する８０００人超の一部に影響を与えるが、工場労働者は対象外となる。年次報告書によると、ＧＳＫの全世界の従業員は昨年末時点で６万６８４１人。

ＧＳＫは引き続きベルギー国内のバイオ医薬品業界で最大の雇用主で、同社のワクチンの大部分は今後も同国で生産し続けると説明した。

同社は提案された変更によって既存ワクチンの一部に対する需要に工場がより適切に対応できると見込んでいる。先月には卵ベースのインフルエンザワクチンの需要減少を理由に、ドイツ東部ドレスデンのワクチン工場を閉鎖する計画を発表している。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 最終更新: 10/15(木) 11:34 ロイター

item.title: 物価上昇リスク「相応にある」、利上げに過度に慎重になることない＝小枝日銀委員
item.description:
Takahiko Wada
［熊本市 １５日 ロイター］ - 日銀の小枝淳子審議委員は１５日、緩和的な金融環境が続くも...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
物価上昇リスク「相応にある」、利上げに過度に慎重になることない＝小枝日銀委員 11:26 配信

日本銀行本店。都内で６月撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada

［熊本市　１５日　ロイター］ - 日銀の小枝淳子審議委員は１５日、緩和的な金融環境が続くもと、物価上昇リスクが「相応にある」ことを踏まえれば、「利上げに過度に慎重になることはない」と述べた。経済・物価に対して引き締め的でも緩和的でもない中立金利は「推計レンジの下限の目安である１％よりは相応に上」と明言した上で、経済・物価の状況を見ながら、政策金利を適時に調整していくべきだと語った。

熊本市で開いた金融経済懇談会であいさつした。

小枝審議委員はこれまで、金融政策運営に当たって重視している基調的な物価上昇率について「総じてみれば２％ぐらい」と指摘し続け、定着しているか注視してきた。今回のあいさつでは、幅広い品目で価格上昇が数年続いていることや、賃金も安定的な上昇がみられるとして「わが国の物価上昇率は、以前より持続的なものに定着しつつある」と踏み込んだ。

地政学リスクの高まりに伴う物価上昇リスクに「以前よりも注意を払う必要がある」とも述べた。市況上昇のみならず、近年では外為市場で「有事の円高」が見られにくくなっていると指摘した。

小枝委員は、経済・物価の動向や金融環境の確認にあたっては「プラスの金利が経済活動の前提となる中で、分析の視野を広げ解像度も上げることも重要」との認識を示した。

日銀スタッフによる自然利子率の推計に基づく中立金利の推計レンジは１．１―２．５％。９月の利上げで政策金利は推計レンジの下限を上回ったが、小枝委員は中立金利は「１％よりは相応に上」と語った。

自然利子率が潜在成長率に近似しているとの前提に立ち、２％物価目標を足せば中立金利は「２％を超えているという見方もある」とする一方で、短期金利の収束値も中立金利の「別の候補」だと説明。長年の非伝統的な金融政策の影響で短期金利はゼロ％近傍の推移が続いたため、「モデル上、短期金利の推計値は低く出てくる」とし、プラスの金利環境への移行を踏まえれば、短期金利の収束値は「以前より高い位置に切り上がっている可能性が相応にある」と述べた。

日銀は６月、来年４月以降は国債買い入れの減額を停止し、月２兆円程度の買い入れを継続することを決めた。小枝委員は「少なくとも数年間は償還額が買い入れ額を大きく上回る状況が続く」とした上で、「引き続きバランスシートが極めて大きい状況を軽視せず、バランスシートの正常化を粛々と進める必要がある」と話した。

中央銀行の国債保有の変化が長期金利に与える影響については「アクティブな拡大期よりパッシブな縮小期のほうが小さい可能性が相応にある」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：漸進的な日銀の緩和修正、ドル130円割れは短期間か＝植野大作氏 コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に コラム：日銀の背中押す春闘、植田総裁会見で占う「次」の展開 コラム：日銀マイナス金利解除、3月のイメージ強めた高田委員の発言 最終更新: 10/15(木) 12:06 ロイター

item.title: UBS mulls moving headquarters from Switzerland if capital rules tighten, WSJ reports
item.description: UBS is preparing contingency plans that could include moving its headquarters out of Switzerland if lawmakers tighten the bank's capital requirements, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UBS (UBSG.S) is preparing contingency plans that could include moving its headquarters out of Switzerland if lawmakers tighten the bank's capital requirements, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The options include acquiring a US financial institution and relocating, merging with a European rival, or selling itself to a US bank, the report said. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. UBS declined to comment. The European lending giant's plans come as Switzerland considers tougher "too-big-to-fail" capital rules following UBS's 2023 rescue of Credit Suisse. Under the government plan, UBS would need to hold an extra $20 billion in Common Equity Tier 1 capital, mainly by requiring its foreign units to be 100% backed by CET1 capital. Currently, they have to be at least 60% backed, largely with CET1 capital. UBS has pushed back against the proposal, saying the 100% requirement is excessive and would hurt its international competitiveness. Earlier this month, US investor Artisan Partners urged [USN:L1N45N061 TEXT:"UBS to leave Switzerland"], arguing that the planned capital requirements were "punitive" and that Switzerland was "no longer an attractive or desirable location" for the bank. Artisan estimated that proposed changes could require UBS to hold an additional $16 billion in common equity capital. However, UBS has been fending off the idea of leaving Switzerland, with Chief Executive Sergio Ermotti [USN:FWN45S1GL TEXT:"telling"] CNBC last week that staying in Switzerland was good for both the economy and shareholders. Last month, Chairman Colm Kelleher warned that UBS would need to carefully [USN:L8N4590WE TEXT:"consider its future"] in Switzerland if new banking rules became too stringent, but said the preferred outcome was to have a "Swiss [USN:L8N4590WE TEXT:"compromise "]that allows us to stay in Switzerland".

item.title: Comedian Russell Brand was a ruthless sexual predator, UK prosecutors say
item.description: British comedian Russell Brand faces 7 charges involving rape, sexual assault and indecent assault against 6 women. He denies all allegations concerning incidents between 1999 and 2009.
item.dc:creator: CNA Lifestyle
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Entertainment

Comedian Russell Brand was a ruthless sexual predator, UK prosecutors say

British comedian Russell Brand faces 7 charges involving rape, sexual assault and indecent assault against 6 women. He denies all allegations concerning incidents between 1999 and 2009.

British actor and comedian Russell Brand arrives at Southwark Crown Court where he stands trial on charges of rape and sexual assault involving six women between 1999 and 2009, which he denies, in London, Britain, October 14, 2026. REUTERS/Jack Taylor

15 Oct 2026 10:08AM

Bookmark

Bookmark

Share

WhatsApp

Telegram

Facebook

Twitter

Email

LinkedIn

Set CNA as your preferred source on Google

Add CNA as a trusted source to help Google better understand and surface our content in search results.

Read a summary of this article on FAST.

Get bite-sized news via a new cards interface. Give it a try.

Click here to return to FAST Tap here to return to FAST

FAST

Actor and comedian Russell Brand, once one of Britain's most high-profile broadcasters, was a ruthless predator who raped or abused six women to satisfy his voracious sexual appetite, prosecutors said on Wednesday (Oct 14). Brand, 51, the former husband of US singer Katy Perry, is on trial facing three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault relating to six women from 1999 to 2009. He denies all the accusations and will set out his defence in court at a later date. "Today I feel blessed," he said as he arrived at London's Southwark Crown Court. "I feel of course concerned but hopeful that this process will lead to good outcomes for everybody involved." DESIRE WAS INDISCRIMINATE, PROSECUTOR TELLS COURT

Russell Brand speaks to the media as he arrives at Southwark Crown Court in London, Wednesday Oct. 14, 2026. (Ben Whitley/PA via AP)

Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones said some of the six women had protested, while others had no opportunity to react to his advances. It had made no difference to Brand, she said. "His desire, his strong desire, for some form of sexual contact was indiscriminate and voracious," she said. Although he could be funny and charming when he wanted something, he also had a childlike expectation his every desire should be met, she added. "He was ruthless, he was calculating, he was manipulative and, the prosecution say, he was a sexual predator," Karmy-Jones said. The alleged offences took place over a decade as Brand progressed from gigs as a stand-up comedian to a TV presenter, actor and Hollywood movie star. FIRST ALLEGED OFFENCE IN 1999

British actor and comedian Russell Brand appears at Southwark Crown Court where he stands trial on charges of rape and sexual assault involving six women between 1999 and 2009, which he denies, in London, Britain, October 14, 2026, in this courtroom sketch. REUTERS/Julia Quenzler

The first is alleged to have occurred in 1999 when he was performing in a show on the fringe of the Labour Party Conference in Bournemouth. The first complainant, who had watched the show and had assumed Brand was gay, said he had raped her in her hotel room where she had invited him to talk. Mark Pinheiro, one of his co-performers at the show who Brand went on to live with for about a year, said Brand bragged that he had wanted to bed 5,000 women in his lifetime. Giving evidence, Pinheiro said on their last morning in Bournemouth, Brand had returned to where they were staying looking flustered and told them they had to immediately leave. Pinheiro said that, a couple of months later, Brand admitted he had met a woman the night before and things "may have gone a little bit too far". Brand's lawyer Ian Winter suggested to Pinheiro that he did not mention that when he first contacted police and no such conversation took place, which Pinheiro rejected. BRAND SAYS HE NEVER ENGAGED IN NON-CONSENSUAL ACTIVITY

Russell Brand speaks to the media as he arrives at Southwark Crown Court in London, Wednesday Oct. 14, 2026. (Ben Whitley/PA via AP)

The second charge relates to 2001, when he is accused of trying to drag a woman into a toilet cubicle at MTV Europe where she worked. Three years later, a woman said he had dragged her into a toilet cubicle in a bar before orally raping her. Around the same time in 2004 or 2005, a woman working at a media company said he indecently assaulted her. The fifth complainant, a fan, had consensual sex at his home in 2009 but then he anally raped her, the prosecutor said. The sixth, who worked for Channel 4, alleges Brand had demanded a massage and then pressed his face into her groin, also in 2009. When interviewed by police, Brand declined to answer questions but provided written statements in which he said he did not remember the incidents and had never engaged in non-consensual activity, Karmy-Jones said. WOMEN CAME FORWARD AFTER TV PROGRAMME The women involved did not know each other and did not contact the police until after a TV programme and a press report in 2023 in which anonymous allegations were made by other women, the prosecutor said. Brand sat in the dock wearing a dark suit and thin, white scarf, staring forward intently. His trial, expected to last about six weeks, has attracted huge media attention. The comedian, known for his flamboyant style and appearance, became famous in Britain before starring in a number of films including "Get Him to the Greek" in 2010, the same year he married Perry. They divorced in 2012. More recently Brand has appeared in online broadcasts discussing US politics, religion and free speech.

Source: Reuters/mm

item.title: Dollar retreats from 18-month high as Treasury yields dip; Fed hike bets ease
item.description: The dollar slipped from an 18-month peak on Thursday as a sharp drop in Treasury yields amid a risk-off mood weighed on the greenback, while cautious remarks from Federal Reserve officials tempered October hike expectations despite hot inflation data.
item.dc:creator: Jiaxing Li
item.content:encoded: The dollar slipped from an 18-month peak on Thursday as a sharp drop in Treasury yields amid a risk-off mood weighed on the greenback, while cautious remarks from Federal Reserve officials tempered October hike expectations despite hot inflation data. The dollar index , which measures the US currency against a basket of peers, fell 0.2% to 101.99, giving back most of the gains it made after Wednesday's stronger-than-expected inflation figures pushed it to an 18-month high. That helped the euro bounce 0.6% from an 18-month trough to $1.1223, putting it on track for its biggest gain in nearly two months. Sterling strengthened 0.4% to $1.3250, recovering from a 13-month low. Markets turned [USN:L6N46100A TEXT:"risk-off"] as the [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"hot CPI reading"] bolstered bets on higher-for-longer Fed rates and revived worries about AI companies' heavy debt burdens, driving safe-haven flows into Treasuries. The rally in US government bonds pushed the benchmark 10-year yield to 5.0933% while the 30-year yield dipped to 5.4462%, both touching three-week lows. "The dollar has gone down in a hurry ... we think the biggest factor has been the decline in 30-year yields," said Rodrigo Catril, senior FX strategist at National Australia Bank. "If the decline in yields were to extend, the dollar could struggle, but at this stage it would suggest that the dollar is probably going to consolidate" with expectations for Fed hikes still high, he added. Market pricing for an October Fed rate hike [USN:L6N4600VL TEXT:"rose sharply"] to 50% on the back of the CPI data, before a chorus of Fed officials - including Vice Chair for Supervision [USN:L1N4600EO TEXT:"Michelle Bowman"] and San Francisco Fed President [USN:L6N4601E8 TEXT:"Mary Daly"] - said the central bank could wait for a clearer picture ahead of the October 27 and 28 meeting, tempering those bets. "Despite the whole CPI number coming slightly stronger than expected, I think markets have sort of taken the view that maybe it was not hot enough to force the Fed's hand for October," said Khoon Goh, the head of Asia research at ANZ. "(The) October (meeting) is also just a few days before the midterm elections as well," he added. "And that's possibly why the market doesn't want to be more aggressive in pricing in for October." The market's focus will now shift to US producer price (USPPM=ECI) and retail sales (USRSL=ECI) data later in the day, with the former expected to show a jump in business costs last month. Investors will also watch remarks from Fed officials including Chair Kevin Warsh at IMF-World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok on Friday for clues on the US central bank's next move. The Australian dollar fetched $0.6952 , down 0.3%, after [USN:L1N46100L TEXT:"local employment"] unexpectedly slid in September. The kiwi traded up 0.6% at $0.5626 . The Japanese yen strengthened to 157.675 per dollar and the Swiss franc was about 0.8% stronger at 0.8282. Elsewhere, the offshore yuan strengthened a touch to 6.6926 per dollar after [USN:L1N460014 TEXT:"data"] showed China's factory-gate inflation heated up last month as commodity costs rose. (This story has been corrected to fix the date for Warsh's IMF speech to Friday from Thursday, in paragraph 12.)

item.content:encoded:

BOJ should not be overly cautious in raising rates, board member Koeda says

Traffic signs in front of the Bank of Japan building in Tokyo, Japan, on Jun 15, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon)

FAST

Bank of Japan board member Junko Koeda said on Thursday (Oct 15) the central bank should not become overly cautious about raising interest rates given considerable upside risks to inflation. Koeda said Japan's financial conditions remain accommodative even after the central bank's past interest rate hikes, with little sign higher borrowing costs were hurting household and business activities. Continued price increases across a wide range of consumer items suggest that underlying inflation is becoming anchored around the BOJ's 2 per cent target, she said. With wages also rising steadily, Japan appears to be making more durable progress towards sustained inflation, Koeda said. "The BOJ should adjust interest rates in a timely manner with an eye on the economic and price situation, while keeping in mind the estimated range of the neutral interest rate," she said in a speech delivered to business leaders in Kumamoto, southern Japan. The BOJ raised its key rate to a 31-year high last month, and signalled a shift toward preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its target, bolstering expectations of further policy tightening. While the BOJ may pause in October, it is likely to drop hawkish hints that would reinforce dominant market expectations of a December hike, sources have told Reuters.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: Oil prices ease as investors weigh supply outlook, Middle East tensions
item.description: Oil prices fell more than 1% on Thursday as investors weighed risks to supply from attacks on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz against US efforts to cut petroleum shipping costs by easing sanctions on vessels.
item.dc:creator: Sam Li, Trixie Yap
item.content:encoded: Oil prices fell more than 1% on Thursday as investors weighed risks to supply from attacks on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz against US efforts to cut petroleum shipping costs by easing sanctions on vessels. Brent crude futures fell $1.76, or 1.7%, to $104.3 a barrel by 0625 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude futures were down $1.06, or 1.1%, to $94.03, reversing gains from the previous session. WTI rose to a three-week high in the prior session after Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis attacked Saudi Aramco's headquarters and Tehran said it was deploying new tactics to target ships in the Strait of Hormuz and keep oil prices high. A container ship and a dry bulk carrier both [USN:L1N4600JW TEXT:"sank"] near the strait in the past 24 hours after being hit by projectiles in separate incidents, maritime officials said on Wednesday. Attacks around the waterway have surged over the past 10 days, with Iran saying it is stepping up strikes in response to the US blockade of its ports and tougher sanctions introduced last month. With the Iran war having disrupted shipping and driven up freight costs to record highs, the Trump administration is considering [USN:L1N46017R TEXT:"easing sanctions"] on so-called shadow-fleet vessels that have transported oil and petroleum products from countries including Russia, Iran and Venezuela to help ease prices, a US official said on Wednesday. The new talks centre on the United States potentially allowing "legal oil" to flow on previously sanctioned vessels, the US official said. Increased output from Russia and the Middle East has kept a lid on prices. Russia's crude oil production [USN:L1N46008R TEXT:"rose"] by 65,000 barrels per day in September to 8.43 million bpd but remained down 870,000 bpd year on year, the International Energy Agency said on Wednesday. The IEA also said crude oil exports from Middle East Gulf producers rose by 4.4 million bpd in September to around 75% of prewar levels. "While there is little concrete evidence of a near-term peace deal, oil continues to find its way to buyers through alternative routes and logistical arrangements," said Phillip Nova's head of market insights, Priyanka Sachdeva, in a client note. "These workarounds have helped prevent a more severe supply shock, although they come at a higher cost and leave global flows vulnerable to further disruption." In the US, crude oil and distillate inventories fell, while gasoline stocks rose last week, market sources said on Wednesday, citing data from the American Petroleum Institute. Crude stocks [USN:L6N4601BW TEXT:"fell by 11.1 million barrels"] in the week ended October 9, sources said. That was a much bigger draw than analysts [USN:L1N46016I TEXT:"polled"] by Reuters expected. "Despite the sharp inventory draw, oil prices barely reacted. The failure to rise on bullish news suggests investors are cautious about chasing prices higher at current levels," said Haitong Futures in a note on Thursday. Official numbers from the US Energy Information Administration are due at 12 p.m. EDT (1600 GMT), delayed by a day following the Columbus Day holiday on Monday.

item.title: オープンＡＩ、アップルに移籍した元従業員が機密情報を漏えいと主張
item.description:
Stephen Nellis Deepa Seetharaman
[ニューヨーク １４日 ロイター] - 生成人工知能...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オープンＡＩ、アップルに移籍した元従業員が機密情報を漏えいと主張 10:04 配信

アップルとオープンAIのロゴ。7月12日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Stephen Nellis　Deepa Seetharaman

[ニューヨーク １４日 ロイター] - 生成人工知能（ＡＩ）モデル「チャットＧＰＴ」の開発元である米オープンＡＩは、アップルに移籍した元従業員が未発表製品に関する１００件を超える機密情報のファイルを自分宛に送信し、数カ月前にアップルの上級幹部に対して内容を漏えいしたとの書類をカリフォルニア州サンノゼの連邦裁判所に１３日提出した。

両社は係争中で、アップルもオープンＡＩに移籍した元従業員が機密情報を持ち出し、オープンＡＩのハードウエア部門に持ち込んだと主張している。オープンＡＩはアップルの主張を否定している。

エドワード・ダビラ判事は、アップルが元従業員の端末からデータを収集することを認め、証言を聞く可能性があると説明した。公判は２０２７年１０月に始まる可能性が高いが、オープンＡＩは２７年６月にも公判の準備が整う可能性があるとしている。

オープンＡＩは提出した書類で、アップルが独自のＡＩ製品の開発を進めていると訴えた。アップルは１３日、スマートホーム端末「ＨｏｍｅＶｉｅｗ（ホームビュー）」を発表した。

オープンＡＩはその上で「当社は営業上の秘密や機密情報がアップル社内で流通し、アップルのエンジニアがオープンＡＩの機密事項や革新的な成果に基づいてアップルの今後の製品を設計できる状況にあることを深く懸念している」とコメントした。

これに対しアップルは、新入社員が元の勤務先の機密情報を使わないためのポリシーと手順を整備しており、オープンＡＩの主張を裏付ける証拠は見つかっていないと反論している。

item.title: Tech stocks tumble as data centre debt worries hit AI trades
item.description: Tech stocks took a beating, credit markets wobbled and bonds rallied on Thursday as crowded bets on data centres and other AI infrastructure faced a reckoning from high and rising interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Gregor Hunter
item.content:encoded: Tech stocks took a beating, credit markets wobbled and bonds rallied on Thursday as crowded bets on data centres and other AI infrastructure faced a reckoning from high and rising interest rates. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) tumbled 3.4% to tally a fourth straight day of losses, led by a plunge of more than 8% in South Korea's KOSPI (.KS11) , while the Nikkei 225 (.N225) fell 5.4%. S&P 500 e-mini futures were down 0.4%. "The selloff in Asia looks less like a sudden deterioration in technology fundamentals and more like a repricing of the cost of capital," said Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo Bank in Singapore. "Investors are not questioning whether AI demand exists," she said. "They are increasingly questioning what price they should pay for that growth when interest rates are high, volatile and potentially moving higher again." Overnight, [USN:L6N4601BJ TEXT:"stocks on Wall Street"] logged their third day of declines after US consumer price inflation accelerated by more than expected in September. The S&P 500 (.SPX) fell 1.1%, the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tumbled 1.9% and a gauge of semiconductor stocks (.SOX) extended losses into a sixth day, as the prospect of [USN:L6N4601B1 TEXT:"higher interest rates"] pummelled shares of Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sensitive to higher borrowing costs. "While the initial selloff was triggered by the hotter-than-expected CPI, tech was the main driver of today’s selloff," JPMorgan analysts wrote in a note. "AI was again the main challenge ... with financing risks and IPO timelines still at the centre of the story." Asian stocks in the tech hardware supply chain were hard hit on Thursday. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (2330.TW) fell 2%, Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) plunged 9.9%, memory chipmakers SK Hynix (000660.KS) and Kioxia Holdings (285A.T) plummeted more than 11% each, and AI investor SoftBank Group (9984.T) lost more than 9%. The cost of insuring AI-linked tech giants against default has also increased, in some cases to record levels, with [USN:L4N4610DV TEXT:"credit default swaps"] widening for cloud computing giant Oracle (ORCL.N) , AI investor SoftBank (9984.T) and data-centre operator CoreWeave (CRWV.O) . Some strategists found reasons for optimism, noting that volumes were relatively light and October is typically a volatile time of year for markets. "I’m not worried, because stocks are not expensive, there is no sign of a recession, and demand still massively exceeds supply in most parts of the AI story," said Mark Matthews, head of research for Asia at Bank Julius Baer in Singapore. Defying the gloom, AI chip giant TSMC (2330.TW) posted a 69% jump in third-quarter [USN:P8N3NB03T TEXT:"net profit"] to a record T$763.1 billion ($23.59 billion) on Thursday, beating market forecasts. In early European trades, pan-region futures were down 0.9%, German DAX futures slipped 0.6% and FTSE futures were 0.2% lower. The backdrop of investor anxiety drove safe-haven buying of government bonds, with the yield on the US 10-year Treasury bond down 8.2 basis points at 5.106%. "We continue to think that yields at current levels offer decent value," DBS analysts wrote in a note. "We are not convinced that the Fed will have to deliver back-to-back hikes on the back of one set of CPI numbers." [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"The inflation data"] reshaped expectations for the Fed's rate path, with traders briefly pricing in roughly even odds of a hike later this month before scaling back those bets. Fed funds futures are now pricing an implied 75% probability the US central bank will remain on hold at the end of its next two-day meeting on October 28, little changed from a day earlier, according to the CME Group's FedWatch tool. "The upside surprise in US CPI and the subsequent rally in bonds is highly counterintuitive," said Prashant Newnaha, senior rates strategist at TD Securities. "The cleanest read through is that the slump in AI is repricing growth expectations down, leading to bonds serving as a hedge for stocks." Against the yen , the US dollar was down 0.2% at 157.975 yen, while the euro was up 0.5% at $1.1211. The Australian dollar declined 0.3% to $0.6954 after employment unexpectedly decreased by 39,300 jobs in September, against expectations of an increase of 20,000. Investor attention turns to speeches from Fed officials speaking in Bangkok, including Chair Kevin Warsh, for clues on the US central bank's next move, as well as US producer prices and retail sales data due for release later on Thursday. In [USN:L1N46101K TEXT:"oil markets"], Brent crude was down 1.3% at $104.71 a barrel as traders weighed up the effects of US sanctions relief on supply against attacks on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.description: [東京 １５日 ロイター] - ＡＩ・半導体関連株が軒並み大幅安。キオクシアホールディングスが午前９時２０分現在、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ・半導体株が大幅安、キオクシアの分割後下げ率30％超 9:43 配信

キオクシアのロゴ。9月3日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 １５日 ロイター] -  ＡＩ・半導体関連株が軒並み大幅安。キオクシアホールディングスが午前９時２０分現在、前日比９％安の１万３３００円台で推移し、東証プライム市場の値下がり率第６位となっているほか、アドバンテストが７％超、東京エレクトロンが５％超の下落率となっている。米国株式市場で半導体株が下落したことを嫌気。ＫＯＳＰＩが５％を超す下げで始まったこともマイナス材料になった。

キオクシアはきょうの下げで、１０月５日の９月末に実施した株式分割後の高値１万９７５０円からの下落率が３２％と３０％を超え、テクニカル面では下降トレンドを示唆する動きとなっている。

１４日の米国株式市場で、フィラデルフィア半導体指数は４．３％下落、６営業日続落となり、連続下落期間は２０２５年５月以来の長さとなった。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
メドレーの産婦人科向けシステムに不正アクセス、患者情報流出の可能性 9:39 配信

［東京　１５日　ロイター］ - メドレーは１５日、産婦人科向けの業務支援システム「アットリンク」への不正アクセスを確認したと発表した。漏えいの有無や範囲は調査中だが、登録された患者の個人情報が外部に漏えいした可能性があるという。漏えい対象となる可能性のある医療機関は最大で７８７件。

１１日に外部専門機関から不正アクセスの可能性に関する情報提供があり、調査の結果、不正アクセスを確認。暫定的な対策を講じた上で被害防止などのため１４日深夜に関連サービスの提供を一時停止したという。

item.description: [東京 １５日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比１．２８％（８６３円９２銭）安の６...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は続落で寄り付く、一時3％安に下げ拡大　ＡＩ・半導体株が大幅安 9:25 配信

都内の株価ボード。6月16日撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

[東京 １５日 ロイター] -   寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比１．２８％（８６３円９２銭）安の６万６８８０円３７銭と、続落してスタートした。その後も下げ幅を拡大し、一時３％安となった。９月消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の発表を受けた米利上げ観測の強まりを受け、売り先行の展開。指数寄与度が高いＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が大幅安となり、全体を押し下げている。韓国の総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）が５％を超す下げとなっていることも嫌気。一方で、ディフェンシブ銘柄を物色する動きもある。

個別では、キオクシアホールディングス、アドバンテスト、東京エレクトロンなど主力銘柄の半導体関連株が大幅安。ソフトバンクグループも軟調に推移し、トヨタ自動車もさえない。半面、ＪＴ、武田薬品工業、良品計画などが年初来高値を更新。ディフェンシブ銘柄や消費関連株の一角が物色されている。

item.title: 米大手行は投資銀行業務の先行きを楽観、見込み案件数「堅調」
item.description:
Arasu Kannagi Basil Prakhar Srivastava
[１４日 ロイター] - 米大手銀行は今...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米大手行は投資銀行業務の先行きを楽観、見込み案件数「堅調」 9:08 配信

バンク・オブ・アメリカのATM。2017年10月11日、米ボストンで撮影。REUTERS/Brian Snyder

Arasu Kannagi Basil　Prakhar Srivastava

[１４日 ロイター] - 米大手銀行は今週の決算発表を通じて、投資銀行業務に楽観的な見方を示した。社債利回りの上昇や市場のボラティリティーが案件の遅れにつながる可能性はあるものの、企業買収や資金調達案件のパイプライン（見込み案件数）は堅調で、顧客との協議も活発に続いている点を理由に挙げている。

米主要銀行の第３・四半期の投資銀行手数料収入は、バンク・オブ・アメリカを除いておおむね増加した。

ＪＰモルガン・チェースのジェレミー・バーナム最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は「金利上昇を受け、市場は買い手と売り手が評価額で折り合えるかを見極めるため一時的に様子見となるだろう。実際、９月後半には若干の減速が見られた」と断りつつも「全体としては案件の中止よりも延期とみるべきだ。実行する必要があり、実行したい案件は数多く存在する」と付け加えた。

シティグループのジェーン・フレーザー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「パイプラインは堅調だ。アドバイザリー業務と資本市場業務の中心は米国であり、欧州やアジアでも多少の持ち直しが見られるが、多くは米国主導だ」と語った。また企業による設備投資の継続や戦略協議の活発化に触れて、企業合併・買収（Ｍ＆Ａ）を巡る全体的な環境は前向きだとの認識を表明した。

過去１年間、投資銀行業界は関税問題や中東情勢など複数の逆風に直面したが、いずれも一時的な慎重姿勢を招いたにとどまり、Ｍ＆Ａ市場の回復腰折れには至らなかった。

モルガン・スタンレーのシャロン・イェシャヤＣＦＯは「戦略的な投資家はここ数週間で買収案件に関する協議を再開した」と述べた。

ゴールドマン・サックスのデービッド・ソロモンＣＥＯは「戦略的なＭ＆Ａの観点では、現政権の下での事業機会が少なくともあと２年超残っている。企業間の協議は非常に活発で、案件残高も極めて潤沢だ」と述べ、企業が規制環境の改善を追い風に積極姿勢を強めていると説明した。

ただ市場関係者の間では、借入コスト上昇や企業価値算定を巡る不透明感が案件の遅延要因になるとの警戒感も根強い。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、第３・四半期の世界のＭ＆Ａ案件総額は９９３０億ドルとなり、前期比４１％減少した。大型案件の減少を背景に、２０２５年第２・四半期以降で初めて１兆ドルの大台も下回った。

一方米国の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）市場は夏場以降、勢いを失っている。市場の不安定化や企業価値評価への懸念から投資家が選別姿勢を強め、上場計画が難しくなっているためだ。

原子力技術企業ホルテックやスマートリングメーカーのオーラなど有力企業が上場計画を延期したほか、ソフトバンクグループが支援するＳＢエナジーも米国でのＩＰＯロードショー開始を先送りした。

ソロモン氏は「９月に状況はやや軟化した。ＩＰＯ市場自体は開かれていたが、期待した評価額より１０－１５％低い水準しか提示されないケースがあった」と述べた。

これに対してモルガン・スタンレーのイェシャヤＣＦＯは、企業が新たな評価水準を受け入れれば案件は再び動き出すとの見方を示した。

それでもＩＰＯ市場の門戸は狭まりつつあり、高金利環境の中で投資家の選別姿勢が強まる中で、バイオテクノロジー分野など一部セクターに関心が集中している。フレーザー氏は「株式市場関連業務は既上場企業による追加増資案件が中心になっている。ＩＰＯ市場は依然として選別的だが、持続的な利益成長が見込める企業にとっては選択肢となる」と語った。

item.title: US considers easing sanctions on shadow fleet vessels to cut freight rates, official says
item.description: The Trump administration is considering easing sanctions on so-called shadow fleet vessels that have transported oil and petroleum products from countries including Russia, Iran and Venezuela, in an effort to reduce record-high global freight rates, a US official said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Timothy Gardner, Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration is considering easing sanctions on so-called shadow fleet vessels that have transported oil and petroleum products from countries including Russia, Iran and Venezuela, in an effort to reduce record-high global freight rates, a US official said on Wednesday. The discussions are happening days after President Donald Trump temporarily [USN:S0N43U024 TEXT:"lifted sanctions"] on Russian diesel fuel, a move met with a torrent of criticism from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, [USN:S8N43U03J TEXT:"European"] countries and some of Trump's [USN:L1N45Z0TJ TEXT:"fellow Republicans"] in the US Senate. Both Zelenskiy and the US senators called that move a gift to Russian President Vladimir Putin that would provide Russia with revenue to keep funding its war in Ukraine. The new talks center on the United States potentially allowing "legal oil" to flow on previously sanctioned vessels, the US official said. That means crude or petroleum products not sanctioned by Washington rather than Russian and Iranian oil, which are under punitive measures. The goal is to get more refined products and crude out of the Gulf, the official said. US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said in a video to the World Petroleum Congress in Riyadh this week that the administration was talking about easing the sanctions on shadow fleet vessels in an effort to cut record freight rates that have cut into demand for US crude, according to Energy Aspects, a research group. Bits of the talk were broadcast on social media, but Reuters was not able to obtain the full video or a transcript. The Department of Energy said it was not available. Companies seeking to use the sanctioned vessels would have to apply to the US Treasury Department to use the vessels, the official said. The Department of Energy said any move to relieve sanctions on the shadow fleet would not help Russia to move oil or oil products. The Treasury Department referred questions to the Department of Energy. But Trump's push to move Russian diesel to global markets quickly could put pressure on the departments to allow shipment via the vessels. The White House did not respond immediately to a request for comment. High oil and fuel prices are a risk for Trump in the November 3 midterm elections in which Republicans are hoping to maintain control of both chambers of Congress. He lifted the sanctions on Russian diesel through April 7. RECORD HIGHS Tanker freight rates have [USN:L4N45U0OZ TEXT:"soared to record highs"] as the wars in Iran and Ukraine have stoked inflation and put US crude oil out of reach for Asian refiners, pushing them to seek alternatives from the Middle East and Latin America. Energy Aspects said in a note to clients that easing the sanctions on the shadow fleet would not greatly impact freight rates but could allow more movement of oil in the Middle East. Lifting the sanctions on the tankers that are mostly old and not well maintained is "unlikely to add meaningful mainstream fleet capacity overnight, especially as most tankers sanctioned over Russian or Venezuelan links have been actively trading over the past three months," it said in the note. Easing the restrictions "could make a small number of additional tankers available for certain (Strait of) Hormuz shuttle runs," in the waterway between Iran and Oman. Lifting the measures is unlikely to result in a broad easing of freight rates as ship insurers will still be bound by EU and UK regulations, maritime industry sources said.

item.title: 機械受注8月は5.2％増、2カ月ぶりプラス 「持ち直しの動き」判断維持
item.description:
Tetsushi Kajimoto
［東京 １５日 ロイター］ - 内閣府が１５日に発表した８月機械受注統計によると...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
機械受注8月は5.2％増、2カ月ぶりプラス　「持ち直しの動き」判断維持 9:01 配信

工場の組立ラインで作業をする人型ロボット。2015年7月1日、埼玉県加須市で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Tetsushi Kajimoto

［東京　１５日　ロイター］ - 内閣府が１５日に発表した８月機械受注統計によると、設備投資の先行指標である船舶・電力を除いた民需のコア受注額（季節調整値）は、前月比５．２％増の１兆０６９８億円と２カ月ぶりに増加した。前月に落ち込んだ反動増となった。

ロイターの事前調査では前月比３．０％増と予想されており、結果は上回った。前年比は１８．６％増と、３カ月連続の増加となり、市場予測の１５．７％増を上回った。

内閣府は、機械受注の判断を「持ち直しの動きがみられる」で据え置いた。

機械受注統計は機械メーカーの受注した設備用機械について毎月の受注実績を調査したもの。振れが大きいことで知られるが、設備投資の先行指標として注目されている。

item.title: 宇宙新興企業の調達額、第3四半期は208億ドル 過去最高
item.description:
Prathik Jayaprakash
[１４日 ロイター] - 英投資会社セラフィム・スペースが１４日に公表した報...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
宇宙新興企業の調達額、第3四半期は208億ドル　過去最高 8:55 配信

スペースX社のスターシップロケット。 2025年1月16日、米テキサス州ブラウンズビル近郊から撮影。REUTERS/Gabriel V. Cardenas

Prathik Jayaprakash

[１４日 ロイター] - 英投資会社セラフィム・スペースが１４日に公表した報告書によると、宇宙関連の新興企業が第３・四半期に調達した資金は過去最高の２０８億ドルとなった。打ち上げ事業者や製造業、その他のインフラ関連事業に投資資金が流入した。

調達額は第２・四半期の７４億ドルの約３倍で、これまでの最高額の２倍超となった。ブルーオリジンによる１００億ドルの資金調達を除いても１０８億ドルと過去最高で、業界全体で需要が拡大していることが示された。

第３・四半期に完了した資金調達案件数も過去最多の２１６件となり、第２・四半期の１４０件から増加した。

セラフィムによると、スペースＸが引き続き業界で圧倒的な存在感を示す一方、最近の資金調達は商業受注や政府支援プログラムの拡大に支えられている。

セラフィムのバイスプレジデント、ルーカス・ビショップ氏は「資本は商業・機関需要を裏付ける証拠を追っており、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）への熱狂の余韻だけによる資金流入ではない」と述べた。

資金調達の大部分を占めたのはインフラ関連企業だった。打ち上げをはじめとする宇宙へのアクセスに携わる企業は１２０件の案件で１６４億ドルを調達。衛星通信や地球観測などの宇宙サービス企業は４０億ドルを調達した。

ビショップ氏によると、各国政府が宇宙分野の能力構築を優先する中、防衛分野や国家レベルの需要が、打ち上げ、製造、軌道上インフラへの投資をますます支えるようになっている。

北米は年初来の世界の資金調達額の約７０％を占めた。中国は４９件の案件で３３億ドルを調達し、四半期ベースで過去最高となった。

Oct 15 : New World Development said on Thursday it expects to issue about $189.1 million in new secured notes due 2032 after receiving sufficient tenders during the early phase of its debt exchange offer, aimed at easing near-term repayment pressures. Here are some more details: • Last week, the Hong Kong property developer launched a debt exchange offer allowing bondholders to swap some notes due in 2027 and 2028 for new secured debt maturing in 2032 • The offer covered three US dollar-denominated note series with a combined outstanding principal amount of about $991 million, including notes due in January 2027, June 2027 and February 2028

item.title: チリの世界最大銅山でスト回避、ＢＨＰと労組が報酬などで合意
item.description:
Fabian Cambero
[サンティアゴ １４日 ロイター] - 豪資源大手ＢＨＰとチリにある同社のエスコンディ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
チリの世界最大銅山でスト回避、ＢＨＰと労組が報酬などで合意 8:24 配信

豪資源大手ＢＨＰのロゴ。2025年9月、オーストラリアのアデレードで撮影。 REUTERS/Hollie Adams

Fabian Cambero

[サンティアゴ １４日 ロイター] - 豪資源大手ＢＨＰとチリにある同社のエスコンディーダ銅鉱山の監督職労働組合は、報酬や福利厚生の改善を巡り合意に達した。これにより、世界最大の銅鉱山でのストライキは回避される。双方が１４日明らかにした。

エスコンディーダでの操業停止の可能性は供給懸念を強め、銅価格を下支えする要因となっていた。

労組は声明で、組合員の６４％が会社側の提案を受け入れ、３５％が反対したと明らかにした。

その上で「本日提示された提案は労組によって承認され、これにより２０２６年の法定団体交渉手続きは終了する」と表明した。

ＢＨＰによると、新たな労働協約の有効期間は３６カ月。固定報酬と変動報酬、既存の福利厚生の改善に加え、新たな賞与やその他の福利厚生も盛り込まれた。

交渉は１３日に始まり、世界の銅市場で重要な役割を果たす同鉱山でのストを回避するため、土壇場での調整が進められた。

労組は、調停で新たな労働協約を締結できなければ、早ければ１４日にもストに入る用意があると警告していた。

item.title: アンソロピック売上高、前期比45％増 ＩＰＯ前会合で成長強調
item.description:
Milana Vinn Krystal Hu
[ニューヨーク／サンフランシスコ １４日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック売上高、前期比45％増　ＩＰＯ前会合で成長強調 8:07 配信

アンソロピックのロゴ。2024年5月に撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Milana Vinn　Krystal Hu

[ニューヨーク／サンフランシスコ １４日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックは１４日、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を前に開いた投資家との会合で、第３・四半期売上高が前期比４５％増の１６８億ドルに達したと説明した。出席した関係者２人が明らかにした。ＡＩシステム開発に伴う巨額コストに対する市場の懸念を和らげる可能性がある。

関係者によると、第３・四半期の売上高は第２・四半期の１１６億ドル、第１・四半期の４７億ドルから拡大した。同社は出席者に対し、第３・四半期は調整後ベースで黒字を達成したと説明したという。

会合は、ＩＰＯを前に潜在的な投資家に同社について理解を深めてもらうことが目的だった。

出席者はアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）とクリシュナ・ラオ最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）と面会した。複数の出席者はロイターに対し、同社の急速な売上高の伸びと黒字化への道筋について楽観的な見方を示した。

出席者の１人によると、アモデイ氏はＡＩの安全性を重視する姿勢を改めて示したが、人類絶滅の脅威には言及しなかった。アンソロピックはロイターが９月に確認した目論見書で、高度なＡＩが「人類にとって壊滅的もしくは存続に関わるリスク」をもたらす可能性があると警告していた。

１４日の会合でアンソロピック幹部は、同社が独自半導体の設計など自社の事業にＡＩをどう活用しているかについて説明したという。

別の出席者によると、同社は今年末までに売上高が年換算で１１００億ドルに達すると見込んでいる。

アンソロピックはコメント要請に応じていない。

アンソロピックのＩＰＯは競合するオープンＡＩの上場に先行する見通しで、大幅な赤字を抱えながら大規模な事業拡大を目指すＡＩ開発企業に対する投資家の需要を測る初期の試金石となる。ロイターは、同社の上場が１１月の米中間選挙後にずれ込む可能性が高いと報じている。

ＡＩ企業が一段と高性能なモデルの開発・運用に必要な半導体やデータセンター、計算能力に巨額の資金を投じる中、各社の財務状況に一段と厳しい目が向けられている。

アンソロピックは２兆ドル超の評価額を目指しており、急成長する売上高が、ＡＩシステムの構築・運用に伴う巨額のコストを最終的に上回ることができると投資家に納得してもらう必要がある。

ロイターは９月、アンソロピックがクラウドサービス、コンピューティング、インフラに関する長期契約に基づき、将来的に数千億ドル規模を支出する見通しだと報じた。

また、ロイターが先月報じたところによると、アンソロピックの昨年の売上高は前年比１２倍の約４６億ドルに急増。営業損失は２倍以上に拡大し、８０億ドルを超えた。

item.title: TSMC forecasts increase in Q4 revenue after posting sixth straight quarter of record profit
item.description: TSMC, the world's largest manufacturer of advanced AI chips, said on Thursday it expects fourth-quarter revenue to rise by as much as 61% from a year earlier, after posting a sixth consecutive quarter of record earnings as it rides an AI boom.
item.dc:creator: Wen-Yee Lee, Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: TSMC, the world's largest manufacturer of advanced AI chips, said on Thursday it expects fourth-quarter revenue to rise by as much as 61% from a year earlier, after posting a sixth consecutive quarter of record earnings as it rides an AI boom. The robust results should help ease concerns that the AI investment surge is losing momentum; they come a day after [USN:L6N4600AA TEXT:"ASML"] (ASML.AS) , the world's largest maker of tools used to make AI chips and advanced semiconductors, provided an upbeat outlook. TSMC's Taipei-listed shares closed down 2% ahead of the earnings release, in line with a broader tech [USN:L6N46104Y TEXT:"sell-off"] amid worries that more interest rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve could pummel shares of AI stocks that are sensitive to higher borrowing costs. Shares of South Korean rivals Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) slid more than 10%. Analysts say demand for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's (TSMC) (2330.TW) AI chipmaking capacity, as well as its advanced chip packaging technology, CoWoS, remains strong. That has catapulted Asia's most valuable company, a key supplier to Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Apple (AAPL.O) , to new heights. Its market capitalisation is almost double that of Samsung Electronics at around $2 trillion. TSMC said net profit in the July-to-September quarter hit T$763.1 billion ($23.59 billion), up 69% from a year earlier and beating a T$746.3 billion LSEG SmartEstimate compiled from 16 analysts. On an earnings call following the results, TSMC said it expects fourth-quarter revenue of $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion, up from $33.73 billion a year earlier. It maintained its capital spending expectation for 2026 at $60 billion to $64 billion. The result was TSMC's highest-ever quarterly net income, as well as its 11th consecutive quarter of profit growth. Last week, it reported a 50% year-on-year rise in [USN:L6N45U0AF TEXT:"third-quarter revenue"], beating market forecasts and hitting a new record. TSMC is investing $265 billion to build chip factories in the US state of Arizona, including an additional $100 billion that was unveiled in July. In September, Reuters reported that TSMC was [USN:L6N45M06T TEXT:"evaluating"] a potential investment in Texas. Tesla CEO Elon Musk also said last week that his companies would build and operate the Terafab AI chip complex, with TSMC potentially subleasing a part of it. On its July earnings call, the company raised its capex forecast for this year to between $60 billion and $64 billion from a previous prediction at the high end of $52 billion to $56 billion. [USN:L6N4600AA TEXT:"ASML"] (ASML.AS) said on Wednesday customers were already looking to place orders for 2029 and 2030, easing concerns that the AI investment boom was losing momentum. TSMC's Taipei-listed shares have gained 57% so far this year, in line with a 62% rise for the broader Taiwanese market. ($1 = 32.3450 Taiwan dollars)

item.title: 新たな欧州債務危機の兆候なし、慎重な財政運営は必要＝欧州委員
item.description: [バンコク １４日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）のドムブロフスキス欧州委員（経済担当）は、ユーロ圏で新たなソブリン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
新たな欧州債務危機の兆候なし、慎重な財政運営は必要＝欧州委員 7:49 配信

欧州連合（EU）のドムブロフスキス欧州委員（経済担当）。9月1日、米ノースカロライナ州アッシュビルで撮影。REUTERS/Sam Wolfe

[バンコク １４日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）のドムブロフスキス欧州委員（経済担当）は、ユーロ圏で新たなソブリン債務危機の兆候は見られないものの、政府・企業の借り入れ増加やインフレ期待の高まりを背景に債務コストが上昇しており、各国政府は慎重な財政運営を行う必要があると述べた。バンコクで開かれている国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の会合でロイターの取材に応じた。

仏１０年債の対独連邦債利回り差は、過去最大の１４０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）近辺で推移している。フランスの高水準の債務と財政赤字に対する懸念に加え、赤字削減に向けた予算案が議会で可決されるかどうかを巡る不透明感が背景にある。

ユーロ圏を崩壊寸前に追い込んだ２０１０─１２年の混乱に続く、新たな欧州ソブリン債務危機の兆しがあるかとの質問に、ドムブロフスキス氏は「ない。ただ、財政政策について慎重になる必要があるのは明らかだ」と述べた。

「これはわれわれがＥＵ加盟国に行っている助言であり、ＩＭＦが国際社会全体に行っている助言とも非常に整合的だ」とした。

フランスの２７年度予算案は、財政赤字の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比率を今年度の５．４％から２７年度には５％に縮小させることを目指している。ただ、２７年４─５月の大統領選に向けた選挙戦により、予算案の成立は不透明になっている。

ドムブロフスキス氏は「フランスは２７年に向けて野心的な予算案を提示した。この予算案を適切な時期に成立させ、フランスの財政見通しの明確さと安定性を示すことが重要だ」と述べた。

他のＥＵ諸国も債務問題を抱えていると指摘したが、欧州の政府債務は現在、平均償還年限が長いため、利回り上昇によって債務返済負担が大幅に増加するまでに、各国政府には対策を講じる時間があるとの見方を示した。

item.title: At Anthropic pre-IPO meet: ‘Thinking’ caps, surging revenue, no human extinction
item.description: Anthropic told prospective investors that revenue in the third quarter surged 45% from the prior quarter, a move that could assuage market concerns about the huge costs of developing AI systems.
item.dc:creator: Milana Vinn, Krystal Hu
item.content:encoded: Anthropic told prospective investors on Wednesday that revenue in the third quarter surged 45% from the prior quarter, two people who attended an investor day said, a move that could assuage market concerns about the huge costs of developing AI systems. Third-quarter revenue rose to $16.8 billion from $11.6 billion in the second quarter and $4.7 billion in the first quarter, the people said. Anthropic told the group the company was profitable on an adjusted basis in the third quarter, they added. The meeting in San Francisco was meant to familiarize prospective Anthropic investors with the company before its highly anticipated IPO. The IPO is expected to precede a public listing by rival OpenAI, making Anthropic an early test of investor appetite for loss-making AI developers investing heavily to pursue massive scale. Its public-market debut is likely to be pushed until after the November US midterm elections , Reuters has reported. Attendees at Wednesday's event met with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao and came away optimistic about the company's rapid revenue growth and path to profitability, a few of them told Reuters as they left its headquarters in the evening. Amodei reiterated the company’s focus on AI safety but avoided mentioning threats of human extinction, one person in the group said. In its prospectus seen by Reuters last month, Anthropic warned that advanced AI could pose "catastrophic or [USN:L4N45K1J5 TEXT:"existential risks to humanity"]." On Wednesday, however, Anthropic executives talked about how the company was using its AI to help its own business including designing a custom chip. The company handed out hats to the attendees, some of which read "thinking." Anthropic could see its annual revenue run rate reach $110 billion by the end of the year, according to estimates from analysts who met with company executives earlier this week. Anthropic did not immediately respond to an email seeking comment. Scrutiny of AI companies' finances has intensified as they pour money into chips, data centers and computing power needed to develop and operate increasingly powerful models. Targeting a valuation of over $2 trillion, Anthropic is seeking to convince investors that its breakneck revenue growth can eventually outrun the enormous costs of building and running AI systems. Last year, Anthropic's revenue increased [USN:L6N45L00B TEXT:"twelvefold to"] nearly $4.6 billion, even as the company lost more than $8 billion on an operating basis, excluding writedowns of various liabilities mostly tied to previous fundraising, Reuters reported exclusively last month. The company has committed at least [USN:L1N45K0RM TEXT:"$518 billion over a decade"] for cloud services, computing and infrastructure. Founded by former OpenAI executives, Anthropic has emerged as one of the leading generative AI developers with its Claude family of models. Its expansion has been underpinned by Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google and Amazon (AMZN.O) , which are simultaneously investors, suppliers of computing power and important distribution partners, as well as AI competitors. Anthropic has also sought to distinguish itself through its focus on AI safety, warning of the dangers posed by increasingly capable systems even as it competes in the race to develop and commercialize more powerful models. Its research has found that its own AI agents have engaged in troubling behavior in test environments, including leaking sensitive information and sabotaging code, though the company has said it has not seen evidence of such misalignment in real-world deployments. The Financial Times first reported the third-quarter revenue figure on Wednesday.

item.title: コアウィーブ株急落、ＣＥＯは受注残の強さ強調 懸念払拭図る
item.description: [１４日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを提供するコアウィーブの株価が１４日、約１５％下落して取...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
コアウィーブ株急落、ＣＥＯは受注残の強さ強調　懸念払拭図る 7:20 配信

コアウィーブのロゴ。7月20日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[１４日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを提供するコアウィーブの株価が１４日、約１５％下落して取引を終えた。マイク・イントレーター最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は従業員向けのメモで、市場は時として「誤解し、非合理的に動く」ことがあると述べ、懸念払拭に努めた。

詳細は以下の通り：

• ロイターが入手した従業員向けメモで、イントレーター氏は、同社の受注残は債務返済義務を十分に賄える規模だと説明。

• 一部競合他社の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）や債務による資金調達で見られる困難や遅延といった問題が「コアウィーブを巡る見方にも波及している」と述べた。

• ブルームバーグによると、コアウィーブの社債価格は、通常ディストレスを示唆する水準まで下落している。

• ブルームバーグはまた、債券取引情報システム「ＴＲＡＣＥ」の価格データを引用し、コアウィーブの２０３２年償還の無担保債が１４日、額面１ドルに対し０．８０ドルを下回る価格で取引されたと報じた。

• コアウィーブは８月に発表した第２・四半期決算で、６月末時点の受注残高が１０４２億ドルと、３月末の９９４億ドルから増加したと明らかにした。さらに、第３・四半期に入り新規顧客による純増契約額が２５０億ドル超に達したとしていた。

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-ＦＲＢ、追加利上げ必要の公算も緊急性ない＝ＳＦ連銀総裁
item.description:
Ann Saphir
[サンフランシスコ １４日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は１４日、過...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-ＦＲＢ、追加利上げ必要の公算も緊急性ない＝ＳＦ連銀総裁 7:07 配信

米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁。4月9日、サンフランシスコで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Ann Saphir

[サンフランシスコ １４日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は１４日、過度に高いインフレを抑制するため、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は短期金利のさらなる引き上げが必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。ただ、１０月２７─２８日の会合で利上げする必要はないとの考えも示唆した。

ロイターのインタビューで「追加の調整が必要になる可能性の方が高いが、時期についてはまだ議論中だ」とし、「限られた情報で決定を下さなければならないという切迫感はない。必要な時間はあると考えている」と述べた。

他のＦＲＢ当局者数人もここ数週間、今月の利上げの可能性は低いことを示唆している。ＦＲＢの政策金利は３．７５─４．００％で、長期の借り入れコストはさらに高い。７．５％の住宅ローン金利などは、経済の一部で需要を抑制する効果が一段と鮮明になっている。

デイリー氏は、経済情勢に応じた政策対応の考え方を示す「反応関数」を金融市場が理解していると感じていると述べた。その例として、１４日発表の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）統計に対する市場の反応を挙げた。９月のＣＰＩ上昇率は前年同月比３．７％に加速し、エコノミスト予想をやや上回った。

デイリー氏は、市場の当初の反応は「強い」もので、金利先物市場では１０月の利上げを見込む取引が急増したが、投資家は統計の詳細を分析した後、「落ち着きを取り戻した」と指摘した。統計では、全体の物価上昇を押し上げたのはガソリン価格の上昇で、基調的なインフレ率は依然として高止まりしているものの、急上昇に転じたわけではなかった。

デイリー氏は「今回の統計は明らかに、インフレリスクが依然として高いことを示している」とした上で、「インフレリスクは一段と高まったが、リスクは現実に起きたことではない。適切な判断を下す時間があるのに、リスクに反応して行動するのは賢明ではないと感じる」と述べた。

労働市場が引き続き安定していることで、ＦＲＢには物価安定に注力する余地があるとした。

ただ、「急ぐ必要がないのに、なぜあえて急ぐのか。時間をかけて慎重に検討すればよいのではないか。この先も会合はある」と述べた。

金融市場は現在、次回会合で２会合連続の利上げが実施される確率を約４０％織り込んでいる。統計発表前から上昇したものの、利上げはもはや最も可能性の高いシナリオではなくなっている。

同氏は、市場について「われわれが物価の安定にコミットしており、それを達成するために必要な措置を講じることを理解している」と述べた。

「（政策当局者は）国民に対して効果的に情報を発信し、説明責任を果たし、透明性と明確性を保つ責任がある」と指摘。「その責任とは、自らの目標が何であるか、何に対して説明責任を負っているか、そしてリスクをどのようにバランスを取るつもりなのかを、人々に極めて明確に伝えることにある」と語った。

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（14日）ナスダック大幅安、ドル上昇 利回り低下
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルがユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇した。米国の９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の伸びが加速したことを受け、連邦...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（14日）ナスダック大幅安、ドル上昇　利回り低下 6:50 配信

＜為替＞ ドルがユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇した。米国の９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の伸びが加速したことを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今月末に開く会合で追加利上げを決定するとの観測が再燃したことでドルに買いが入り、主要通貨に対するドル指数は約１年半ぶりの高値を付けた。ただ、その後はＦＲＢは慎重な姿勢を維持するとの見方が再び広がり、ドルは上げ幅を縮小した。

労働省が朝方発表した９月のＣＰＩは前年比３．７％上昇と、伸びは８月の３．４％から加速。エコノミスト予想の３．６％も上回った。変動の大きい食品とエネルギーを除くコアＣＰＩは前年比２．６％上昇。８月の２．４％から加速し、予想の２．５％も上回った。

終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．３４％高の１０２．５３。朝方の取引では１０２．９４まで上昇し、２０２５年４月以来の高水準を付けていた。

ユーロ／ドルは０．４１％安の１．１１５２ドル。一時約１７カ月ぶりの安値を更新した。英ポンド／ドルは０．５９％安の１．３１７７ドル。

ドルは対円では０．０８％安の１５８．１６円と、小幅ながら下落した。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ ほぼ全ての年限で国債利回りが低下した。朝方発表された米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）を受けて上昇していたものの、終盤にかけて反転した。

この日の利回りの反転は、消費者物価データの加速と、インフレ抑制に向けて追加利上げを急ぐ必要はないことを示唆する連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者らの「忍耐姿勢」との間で、市場での議論がますます活発化していることを浮き彫りにした。

１０年債利回りは２．７ｂｐ低下の５．１９％。取引序盤では５．３２９３％まで上昇していた。

３０年債利回りは４．２ｂｐ低下の５．５２１％と、４日連続低下の見通しとなった。取引序盤では５．６２７７％まで上昇していた。

金利動向に敏感な２年債利回りは０．９ｂｐ上昇の４．８０２％。序盤には９月２９日以来の高水準となる４．９５２１％を付ける場面もあった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ナスダック総合指数が大幅安で取引を終えた。この日発表された９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回り、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による追加利上げへの懸念が強まった。

借り入れコスト上昇の影響を受けやすいオラクル、コアウィーブ、ネビウスなど人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が売り込まれた。オラクルは８．８％安、コアウィーブとネビウスはそれぞれ１５％、１０％下落した。

ＡＩサーバーメーカーのデル・テクノロジーズとヒューレット・パッカード・エンタープライズはそれぞれ１１．４％、８．２％下落。バークレイズが両社の投資判断を「オーバーウエート」から「イコールウエート」に引き下げた。

一方、アップルは０．５％上昇し、終値ベースの時価総額が初めて５兆ドルを上回った。

ナスダック総合は７月２３日以来の大幅な下落率を記録した。ダウ工業株３０種は小幅に下落した。

金融大手バンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）は４．８％下落した。マネーロンダリング（資金洗浄）の疑いがある取引を検知できなかったことに対する規制当局の制裁金に関連し、１２億ドルの費用を計上し、第３・四半期は減益となった。モルガン・スタンレーは四半期決算が増益だったにもかかわらず、３％近く下落した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞  米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）が予想を上回る伸びとなり、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ観測が強まったことで、金相場は３営業日連続で下落した。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比１．７％安の１オンス＝４１０７．９０ドル。現物金は午後２時５分（米東部時間）時点で１．８％安の４０８３．９４ドルと、７日以来の安値を付けた。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 上昇。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアの石油大手サウジアラムコの本社を攻撃したほか、イランが原油価格を高止まりさせるため、船舶への攻撃に新たな戦術を導入していると表明したことが背景。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．３７ドル（０．３５％）高の１バレル＝１０６．０６ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．９５ドル（１．０１％）高の９５．０９ドルで、３週間ぶりの高値となった。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: ＦＲＢ、物価圧力高止まりなら要対応 ＣＰＩ「失望的」＝シカゴ連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[１４日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１４日、労働省が発表...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ、物価圧力高止まりなら要対応　ＣＰＩ「失望的」＝シカゴ連銀総裁 6:08 配信

８月２８日撮影　REUTERS/Ann Saphir

Michael S. Derby

[１４日 ロイター] - 米シカゴ地区連銀のグールズビー総裁は１４日、労働省が発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）について、市場予想を上回る物価圧力が示され、失望させられる内容だったと述べた。

グールズビー氏はヤフー・ファイナンスのインタビューに対し「総合指数だけでなく、内訳を見ても、サービス分野のインフレには改善の兆しがほとんど見られなかった」とし、物価圧力の動向を懸念していると述べた。

その上で、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はインフレ率を目標とする２％に戻すと改めて表明。ＦＲＢが取るべき金融政策対応については言及を避けたものの、高いインフレ圧力が続くことは容認できないと強調。「需要の過熱を防がなければならない。需要主導の過熱は持続性が高く、解消するのは極めて難しい」とし、「インフレ圧力が高止まりすれば、ＦＲＢの対応に曖昧さはない」と語った。

労働省が朝方発表した９月のＣＰＩは前年比３．７％上昇と、伸びは８月の３．４％から加速。エコノミスト予想の３．６％も上回った。

ＦＲＢは今月２７─２８日に連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を開く。グールズビー総裁は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持っていない。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に コラム：ＦＲＢが物価2.0％目指せば、利下げ開始は大幅遅延に コラム：市場の米利下げ織り込み、昨年と同様に過剰ならドル150円も＝佐々木融氏 コラム：マイナス金利解除後の政策占うＣＰＩ、上下2つのシナリオ コラム：下げ止まらない日本円の購買力、失地回復への処方箋は＝植野大作氏 最終更新: 10/15(木) 6:08 ロイター

US states seek children's data protections in Character.AI bankruptcy

FAST

Oct 14 : A group of 40 state attorneys general on Wednesday urged a US bankruptcy judge in Delaware to protect young users of Character.AI and keep their data safe during the AI companion company's bankruptcy. Character.AI filed for bankruptcy late on Monday and is seeking to use its Chapter 11 case to resolve the states' investigations and lawsuits, license its technology to Disney for $20 million, and seek a buyer willing to take on its chatbot business.  Abigail Ryan, an attorney for the states, told US Bankruptcy Judge Brendan Shannon in Wilmington that the states are negotiating a settlement with Character.AI over allegations that its chatbots impersonated licensed medical professionals and exposed children to sexualized and abusive interactions. Even so, Ryan said, the states want to make sure that any buyer of Character.AI's assets will protect users' chat histories and improve safety features.

"We're willing to work with the buyers to find safeguards, but we don't want to see what has transpired in the past start over with a new purchaser," Ryan said at the company's first hearing in US bankruptcy court. "This company has collected some of the most private thoughts children have ever shared, and now those conversations could be sold off to the highest bidder," New York Attorney General Letitia James, a Democrat, said in a Wednesday statement issued just before the court hearing.   NO OFFER YET Character.AI's attorney, Erin Fay, said she heard those concerns "loud and clear," but said that no buyer has yet made an offer for the company's user data or its operating chatbot business. The company's platform allows users to interact with and create generative AI characters customized by user prompts and often modeled on fictional characters, celebrities, and historical figures. Its active users spend an average of two hours a day talking to the chatbots. Beyond the states' claims, Character.AI has been sued by families who allege that its chatbots gave harmful advice, contributed to the suicides of two children, and exposed children to sexualized and bullying interactions. Character.AI has reached preliminary settlements with five of those families. The company also faces investigations by the US government and by authorities in the UK, Italy, Russia and Australia. Disney has agreed to pay $20 million to license the company's technology and intellectual property, as well as hiring most of Character.AI's staff, but is not interested in the type of data that the state AGs are worried about, Fay said. Disney's asset purchase must be approved by the bankruptcy court, and it is subject to higher offers. Fay described a grim mood within the company in recent months, saying that employees "were very excited about the product and the user base" but had "lost faith in the company's trajectory." The company attributed its bankruptcy to legal expenses and the high price for computing power and AI talent, saying it was losing between $8 million and $9 million a month before filing for Chapter 11 protection.  Character.AI's management became concerned about its ability to survive employee attrition by late summer. In September, Disney stepped in to hire most of the company's employees and allow them to work on keeping Character.AI afloat during a bankruptcy sale process and technology transition, according to court filings.

Source: Reuters

US company announces progress toward resurrecting the extinct dodo

FAST

Oct 14 : A US biotech company says it is making progress toward its goal of resurrecting the dodo, the famous flightless bird with a large hooked beak, and returning it to its native Indian Ocean island of Mauritius, where humans drove it to extinction in the 17th century. Dallas-based Colossal Biosciences said on Wednesday it has used a newly developed AI platform to identify genetic changes that may be responsible for the dodo's distinctive craniofacial traits as its scientists pursue gene-editing targets to bring back this lost species. Colossal is planning to perform gene-editing to bring dodo traits into the cells of its closest living relative, the Nicobar pigeon. Native to some Southeast Asian islands, the Nicobar pigeon is known for its shimmering green and copper feathers and, unlike the dodo, can fly. The company said it is in the final stages of its analysis of the dodo genome, now filled to 95 per cent. It also said it has made an advance that should shorten the time needed to test whether a genetic edit produces the desired trait. The company did not announce a timeframe for hatching a dodo.

Colossal says it is dedicated to "de-extinction" — resurrecting vanished species. Last year, it said it had genetically engineered the dire wolf by editing the genes of the gray wolf, the extinct Ice Age predator's closest living relative, to add dire wolf traits. Besides the dodo and dire wolf, Colossal has four other species on its de-extinction list: the woolly mammoth; the thylacine, also called the Tasmanian tiger; the bluebuck antelope; and the moa, a large flightless bird. "The dodo is the world's best-known symbol of extinction caused by people. It disappeared within decades of humans arriving on Mauritius, largely because of the introduction of invasive species like rats and other animals they brought. Bringing it back shows extinction doesn't have to be permanent," Ben Lamm, Colossal's CEO and co-founder, told Reuters. "The big hurdles ahead are proving which genetic changes really matter, making many of those edits in a bird and passing them to the next generation, and preparing a safe home for dodos on Mauritius," Lamm said. The dodo was a ground-nesting bird about 3 feet (1 metre) tall and weighing up to about 50 pounds (23 kg). Having never encountered humans, dodos exhibited no fear of the people who reached Mauritius in the 16th century. Pressured by invasive species and human hunting, the last living dodo was seen in 1662. It has remained alive in popular culture including in Lewis Carroll's book "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland." GENOMORPH PLATFORM Ancient DNA is always broken into small pieces, so no ancient genome is perfectly complete, including that of the dodo. The new AI platform Colossal built is called GenoMorph. "The challenge was scientists only have one complete dodo genome, making it difficult to distinguish the genetic differences that made the dodo unique from ordinary genetic variation. GenoMorph effectively acts as a 'treasure map' for the dodo genome, narrowing hundreds of thousands of possible genetic changes into the targets most likely to explain its iconic beak and facial structure," Lamm said. Beth Shapiro, Colossal's chief science officer, said GenoMorph finds likely gene-editing targets for species with very little surviving DNA. Normally scientists compare many genomes from one species to find the genes behind a trait, but this is not possible with the dodo, Shapiro said. "So instead, GenoMorph studies how skulls and beaks develop across more than 70 living bird species and learns which genetic switches control their shape. It gave us a shortlist of about 2,300 candidates linked to beak size and shape. These targets are now being validated in the lab," Shapiro said. Colossal said it has expanded its colony of Nicobar pigeons in Texas to 36 birds following successful breeding among established pairs. It said this should help in studying Nicobar pigeon development, reproduction and genetics. Lamm said the company is working with Mauritian scientists, conservation groups and the Mauritius government on what bringing the dodo back to its native land might look like. "Getting Mauritius ready for dodos also means removing invasive predators and restoring habitat, which helps the native species living there now," Lamm said. "No release sites will be chosen until the ecological work and community consultation are finalized, but it is Colossal's goal to put our dodos back into their natural habitats in Mauritius."

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、9月ＣＰＩ上振れで追加利上げ観測再燃
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １４日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルがユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇した。米国の９月の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、9月ＣＰＩ上振れで追加利上げ観測再燃 5:42 配信

２０１１年１月撮影　REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

［ニューヨーク　１４日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルがユーロなどの主要通貨に対し上昇した。米国の９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）の伸びが加速したことを受け、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今月末に開く会合で追加利上げを決定するとの観測が再燃したことでドルに買いが入り、主要通貨に対するドル指数は約１年半ぶりの高値を付けた。ただ、その後はＦＲＢは慎重な姿勢を維持するとの見方が再び広がり、ドルは上げ幅を縮小した。

労働省が朝方発表した９月のＣＰＩは前年比３．７％上昇と、伸びは８月の３．４％から加速。エコノミスト予想の３．６％も上回った。変動の大きい食品とエネルギーを除くコアＣＰＩは前年比２．６％上昇。８月の２．４％から加速し、予想の２．５％も上回った。

ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁やボウマンＦＲＢ副議長らからハト派的な発言が相次いでいたが、こうした発言による影響は９月ＣＰＩ統計を受けて後退した格好となった。また、インフレ圧力が経済全体に広がりつつあるとの懸念が広がる中、ＦＲＢがこの日の午後に発表した地区連銀経済報告（ベージュブック）で、米国の労働市場は雇用も解雇も低水準にとどまる状態が続く一方、一部地域でインフレ圧力が強まっていることが示された。

ステート・ストリート（ボストン）のシニア・グローバル市場ストラテジスト、マービン・ロー氏は「ドルを買い進める新たな材料が加わった」と指摘。メシロー・カレンシー・マネジメントのシニア投資ストラテジスト、ウト・シノハラ氏は「労働市場の弱さを示す兆候が出ていることで、物価安定と最大雇用というＦＲＢが担う２つの責務は互いに緊張関係にある」と指摘。「個人消費、労働市場、物価圧力を巡る状況は、１５日に発表される小売売上高、新規失業保険申請件数、卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）などの指標でより明確になる」と述べた。

ＦＲＢは９月１５─１６日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりで、決定は全会一致だった。９月のＣＰＩ統計発表直後、今月２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣで追加利上げが決定される確率は約４５％と、ＣＰＩ統計発表前の約２２％から上昇した。ただその後は利上げ観測はやや後退し、ＣＭＥフェドウォッチによると、１０月のＦＯＭＣで金利据え置きが決定される確率は６５％。同時に、２０２７年末までに合計約７９ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが実施されるとの予想も織り込まれている。

アンジェレス・インベストメンツのマイケル・ローゼン最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は、投資家の間で米国がインフレ抑制に取り組む姿勢への信認が低下しつつあると指摘。「金利上昇に支えられ、ドル高が進んでいる」とし、「ＦＲＢが大幅な利上げによって景気後退を招くか、米政府の通商政策や移民政策が修正されない限り、インフレは低下しない」と述べた。

終盤の取引で主要６通貨に対するドル指数＜=USD＞は０．３４％高の１０２．５３。朝方の取引では１０２．９４まで上昇し、２０２５年４月以来の高水準を付けていた。

ユーロ／ドル は０．４１％安の１．１１５２ドル。一時約１７カ月ぶりの安値を更新した。英ポンド／ドルは０．５９％安の１．３１７７ドル。

ドルは対円では０．０８％安の１５８．１６円と、小幅ながら下落した。

item.title: What is Starshield, SpaceX's military version of Starlink?
item.description: Ukraine said on Wednesday that Elon Musk's SpaceX had restricted military-grade Starlink services, hampering Ukrainian drone strike missions and air defenses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukraine said on Wednesday that Elon Musk's [USN:L8N4600M6 TEXT:"SpaceX had restricted "military-grade" Starlink services"], hampering Ukrainian drone strike missions and air defenses. The complaint has drawn renewed attention to the distinction between Starlink, SpaceX's commercial satellite internet service, and Starshield, a military version developed for the Pentagon. While Musk has said the two systems are separate, in many cases they share the same underlying satellite technology. "Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government," Musk said on Wednesday in a post on X, adding that any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military or the president. "Starlink is a commercial service owned and controlled by SpaceX. Usage of Starlink is limited to civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company." WHAT IS STARLINK? Starlink, the main profit engine of SpaceX (SPCX.O) , is a satellite internet network of more than 11,000 satellites that beam broadband service directly to user terminals about the size of a folded newspaper. Its roughly 13 million subscribers range from households and hikers to shipping companies and major airlines. Since launching its first Starlink satellites in 2019 aboard reusable SpaceX rockets, the company has built a vast low-Earth-orbit constellation that blankets much of the planet, delivering faster connections than traditional communications satellites, which typically operate much farther from Earth and in far smaller numbers. Starlink gave Ukraine a critical communications advantage early in the war, reshaping how militaries operate on the battlefield. But Musk has restricted Starlink for certain military uses while highlighting Starshield, a more secure network developed for government and military missions. WHAT IS STARSHIELD? Starshield is a SpaceX business unit that develops military and intelligence satellite systems for the Pentagon. While its missions are separate from Starlink's commercial broadband service, the distinction is not always clear-cut: Starshield's secure communications services use enhanced encryption and dedicated terminals, but rely on the vast Starlink constellation as their backbone. Starshield leverages the technology, engineering and operational experiences of Starlink, according to SpaceX. In addition to secure communications, the company says the militarized version can also provide users with Earth observation and the ability to integrate sensors or other payloads. The Pentagon, Starshield's largest customer, has spent billions of dollars on both Starlink and Starshield services. It has also bought dedicated Starshield satellites, including communications spacecraft for missile-warning missions and a spy constellation for the National Reconnaissance Office, Reuters reported in 2024. Questions over the relationship between Starlink and Starshield have persisted since [USN:L1N31S38K TEXT:"Russia threatened Western satellites supporting Ukraine in 2022"]. SpaceX unveiled Starshield later that year, but the secrecy surrounding national security space programs has left the precise boundaries between the two systems opaque. Those distinctions became a point of contention earlier this year when the [USN:L6N41W1B2 TEXT:"Pentagon clashed with SpaceX over higher prices for satellite services"] used by military drones during the Iran conflict, Reuters reported. SpaceX argued that some customers paying roughly $5,000 per terminal for Starlink should instead have been using a Starshield service costing about $25,000 per terminal. [USN:L6N4290XG TEXT:"Britain has also adopted Starshield"]. Under that arrangement, the service uses the same satellite constellation, ground stations and terrestrial infrastructure as Starlink, but operates through dedicated terminals and separate network gateways, Britain’s defence ministry has told Reuters. Other US partners are evaluating the system as well. New Zealand is doing a trial of Starshield to assess its usefulness for military operations, the New Zealand Defence Force previously told Reuters.

item.title: Pope Leo back on his feet after shock cancer diagnosis
item.description: Pope Leo's recovery from surgery is progressing as expected and he has begun walking in his hospital room, the Vatican said.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Pope Leo back on his feet after shock cancer diagnosis

Pope Leo's recovery from surgery is progressing as expected and he has begun walking in his hospital room, the Vatican said.

Pope Leo arrives at Gemelli Hospital ahead of the pontiff's surgery to remove a lung nodule in Rome, Italy, on Oct 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Guglielmo Mangiapane)

15 Oct 2026 02:42AM (Updated: 15 Oct 2026 07:24AM)

VATICAN CITY: Pope Leo 's recovery from surgery is progressing as expected and he has begun walking in his hospital room and eating normally, the Vatican said on Wednesday (Oct 14), after doctors announced the 71-year-old pontiff was being treated for lung cancer . World leaders, Catholics across the globe and senior cardinals at the Vatican have offered prayers for Pope Leo after he had part of his right lung removed in an operation on Tuesday. Blood tests and a chest X-ray carried out on Wednesday showed normal post-operative results, the Vatican said, adding that the pontiff had undergone respiratory physiotherapy. The cancer diagnosis for a pope known to be relatively young and energetic and who was elected only in May 2025 caused shock and raised questions about the future shape of his papacy as he deals with the illness.

Pope Leo normally follows a very busy schedule. He is due to make a tour of Uruguay, Argentina and Peru from Nov 6 to 17 and the Vatican press office said on Wednesday that "nothing has changed" regarding the planned trip. However, Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori said on Wednesday that the dates could change because of the amount of time his recovery would take. The pope is the ultimate earthly authority for the world 's 1.4 billion Catholics and does not have a deputy who steps in when he is sick. When a pope is incapacitated, the business of the Vatican's vast bureaucracy carries on as usual, holding off on any decisions that require papal approval.

PRAYERS FOR POPE LEO A prayer was recited for Pope Leo to have a good convalescence and complete healing during an open-air Mass in St Peter's Square on Wednesday following the surgery. The pope has been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer , and doctors removed the lower lobe of his right lung during Tuesday's operation in an effort to eliminate all cancer ous tissue. Human lung s have five lobes - three in the right lung and two in the left. The operation lasted about 90 minutes and was completed without complications, the pope 's lead surgeon, Professor Stefano Margaritora, and his personal physician, Dr Luigi Carbone, said late on Tuesday. The Vatican has not disclosed the size of the tumour or whether the disease had spread to nearby lymph nodes, key factors in determining prognosis. Dr Serena Ricciardi, a lung cancer specialist at Rome's San Camillo Forlanini Hospital, said that if the cancer had not spread to Pope Leo 's lymph nodes, the surgery may have been sufficient for treatment. "If there are no further issues or lymph node involvement, we could consider the surgery curative," she told Reuters. "The disease has been completely removed." Pope Leo is relatively young for a Church leader. He enjoys sports, including tennis, and is not known to be a smoker or to have had recent health issues.

Related:

What we know about Pope Leo's lung cancer diagnosis

Pope Leo recovering after lung cancer operation

ENGAGEMENTS CANCELLED UNTIL NEXT WEEK The Vatican said this week that the pope was expected to remain in hospital for about a week and that all his public engagements had been cancelled until Oct 20. The Mass on Wednesday was the closing act of an assembly of bishops called by Pope Leo to discuss the Church's family life teachings, the largest gathering of Church leaders so far during this papacy. Filipino Cardinal Luis Tagle led the service in place of Pope Leo . The pope last week approved Tagle as the dean of the Church's College of Cardinals, in the first selection of an Asian cleric to the elite role. Political leaders offered messages of support. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said he and his wife Jeanette were praying for the pope , an American who was born in Chicago. "May the Lord give him strength and the Holy Spirit guide the medical professionals taking care of the Holy Father," he said on X. Rubio met Pope Leo at the Vatican in May. There was no immediate response on social media from US President Donald Trump, who has criticised the pope , or from Vice President JD Vance, who is a Catholic.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: US inflation heats up in September; Fed rate hike this month back on table
item.description: US inflation rose to 3.7 per cent in September, driven by higher gasoline prices, increasing pressure on households and complicating the Federal Reserve’s decision on interest rates.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

US inflation heats up in September; Fed rate hike this month back on table

US inflation rose to 3.7 per cent in September, driven by higher gasoline prices, increasing pressure on households and complicating the Federal Reserve’s decision on interest rates.

A motorist fills up his tank at a gas station amid a fuel shortage in Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia, Wednesday, Oct 14, 2026. (Photo: AP/Firdia Lisnawati)

15 Oct 2026 01:53AM (Updated: 15 Oct 2026 07:08AM)

WASHINGTON: US consumer prices accele rate d in September as the cost of gasoline surged, dealing another blow to US President Donald Trump and his Republican Party ahead of the Nov 3 midterm elections and putting an interest rate increase later this month back on the radar. The Consumer Price Index report from the Labour Department on Wednesday (Oct 14) showed a broadening of price pressures beyond energy, raising concerns among economists that underlying inflation could be getting sticky. Financial markets now see the Fed eral Reserve's interest rate decision this month as a closer call than before the data was released. The report added to surveys this month that showed a further deterioration in consumer sentiment and a plunge in Trump's approval rating, driven by angst over the rising cost of living. A Reuters/Ipsos poll showed about 78 per cent of Americans blamed Trump's policies, including tariffs on imports and the Middle East conflict, for rising prices, which are outpacing wages. "The inflation we're experiencing right now is largely the result of erratic policy from the executive branch," said Kyle Moore, chief economist at the Century Foundation, a progressive think tank.
